item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live in Alviso and I am strongly OPPOSED to the proposed Terra Verde data center off Gold Street. Alviso already sits below sea level and floods — the last thing we need is acres of concrete and a facility drawing millions of gallons for cooling. Who gets the water when there's a drought, us or the servers?

This belongs nowhere near a flood-prone residential community. Please vote no.

[name removed]
subject: Strongly oppose the Terra Verde data center

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text: I know everyone's mad but honestly I SUPPORT the Terra Verde project. North San Jose has empty industrial lots doing nothing. Construction jobs, tax base, and it's an industrial zone — not someone's backyard. We can't say no to everything and then complain about the budget. Build it.
subject: data center = more jobs, I support it

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a hydrologist and an Alviso resident. I'm not reflexively anti-development, but the Terra Verde EIR appears to understate groundwater and cooling-water demand and does not adequately model cumulative flood impacts. I OPPOSE certification of the EIR as written and request an independent peer review before any vote.

I'm happy to provide technical comments. Thank you.

[name removed], PhD
subject: Request for independent environmental review — Terra Verde

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text: I'm genuinely torn. We need the tax revenue and the land is industrial. But I also worry about water and traffic on Zanker. I guess I'd support it IF there were strong water-recycling requirements and a community benefit agreement. Without those I lean no. Just sharing honestly.
subject: mixed feelings on Terra Verde

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

I'd ask the city to attach reasonable conditions on water recycling, but on balance this is good for San Jose's economy. Please approve it.

Regards,

subject: Support Terra Verde with conditions

text:

text:

We live just off Santa Teresa Blvd near Steinbeck Dr. The alley behind our building is filled with mattresses, broken furniture, and tires most weekends, and nobody seems to be in charge of cleaning it. I have a toddler and I worry about needles and broken glass mixed into the pile. Our landlord says the city has to handle it because it is public property, so we just wait and watch it get worse.

I am asking the city to take responsibility for clearing the alley and to set up a regular cleanup schedule.

Regards,

subject: Our alley is a dump

text:

People are leaving bags of trash and a broken dresser right next to the bus stop on our corner. Seniors waiting for the bus have to stand in the street to avoid it.

Could the city remove it and check if the bus stop area needs a camera?

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Dumping near the bus stop

text:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Summer Dr y Ford Rd desde hace 20 años. Vecinos dejan escombros de construcción y pedazos de madera junto al sendero del arroyo cada fin de semana. Los perros se enredan con los clavos y ya dos personas se cortaron.

Les pedimos que limpien el área y que pongan letreros de multa.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Escombro junto al arroyo

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Please send someone to take it away.

Thanks,

Someone left a TV and three folding chairs in the alley by our garage, and they have been there for over a week. The rain has ruined the chairs and the TV is starting to leak something onto the pavement.

I want the city to remove them and tell residents how to request a bulky pickup.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Chairs and a TV

Please add lighting or a camera on the alley side so the city can catch them.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Dumping at night

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

Dumping at our lot happens again every few weeks, and we are tired of paying to clear it.

Sincerely,

subject: Recurring dumping at our lot

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Đổ rác bừa bãi bên suối

text:

I've lived in Blossom Valley since 1999. A mattress was dumped against our back fence, and the frame underneath is now on the sidewalk too. It is the third time this year the back fence has been used as a drop spot.

Please remove the whole pile and check the lot behind us for more.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Mattress by the fence

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Can someone clear it out this week?

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Trash in the bushes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Cada semana aparece un sillón, una cama o bolsas de ropa tiradas cerca del sendero del arroyo detrás de nuestra casa. Mi mamá es mayor y ya se tropezó con una silla escondida entre los arbustos. Llamamos al 311 varias veces, pero siempre tardan días en venir.

Pedimos que la ciudad recoja todo y ponga vigilancia en esa zona.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Muebles tirados cerca del arroyo

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Hello,

Someone is dumping furniture and tires next to the loading dock behind our store, probably at night. I run a shop near the corner of Tobago Ave and Boa Vista Dr. It blocks the delivery truck every time, and drivers have complained.

We want the city to remove it promptly and check whether a camera can be placed there.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Dumping near our loading dock

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Our block had a cleanup last spring, and by now the same spots are full of junk again, including a broken washer. I do not know who to call for a washer since it is not garbage day.

Could the city set up a more regular cleanup schedule for our block?

[name removed]
subject: Cleanup again on our block

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Dear Councilmember,

It is almost impossible to get a bulky item pickup appointment in less than a month.

Please add more open slots or a same-week option for seniors.

[name removed]
subject: Bulky pickup appointments

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I have a broken dresser and a crib that need hauling, but the free junk pickup in our area fills up within minutes. I live by Redwood Drive and Birch Way with my family. I had to pay a hauler two hundred dollars last time, which I could not really afford.

I want the city to expand the free pickup days or give renters a second option.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Free junk pickup

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Our garbage was missed for the third week in a row, and the cans sit at the curb until the next day and the raccoons get into them. I called the 311 line each time and got a ticket number but no explanation. Our elderly neighbor cannot drag her bins back up the driveway, so her trash just stays out.

Please check our route and make sure the crew comes on the scheduled day.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Missed garbage pickup again

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Estimados concejales,

Vivimos en Village Oaks desde hace 27 años. La basura no la recogen desde hace dos semanas en mi cuadra, aunque los botes ya están llenos. Mi esposo trabaja de noche y no puede esperar en la calle para reportarlo.

Quisiera que el camión pase a su horario y que me digan por qué fallaron.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Recolección de basura

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
The public trash can at the corner outside our restaurant overflows every single day.

Please add a second can or more frequent emptying there.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Dumpster overflow

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The graffiti on the wall by our bus stop gets painted over and then it is back within a week. It looks like the same tags, so I think the crew should wait for a better fix rather than a quick paint job.

Please use a longer-lasting coating and remove it faster when people report it.

[name removed]
subject: Graffiti keeps coming back

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Farthing Way và Piedmont Rd. Thùng rác công cộng ở góc đường gần nhà tôi lúc nào cũng đầy và rác tràn ra vỉa hè. Mấy con chó hoang tha rác ra đường rất bẩn và mùi rất khó chịu.

Cảm ơn quý vị,

subject: Thùng rác công cộng

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup

Please install cameras and post signs on the poles.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Cameras at the dump spot

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En la esquina de mi casa siempre queda la basura de la semana sin recoger y la gente deja muebles encima. Vivimos en Dry Creek desde hace 20 años. Ya fui a la oficina de la ciudad dos veces y me dijeron que esperara. Mi hijo se pone enfermo del olor cuando hace calor y no tenemos a dónde irnos.

Pido que la ciudad ponga cámaras y pase más seguido por esa esquina.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Basura y muebles en la esquina

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Our apartment managers say bulky item pickup must be scheduled by the owner, so renters have no way to request it. I live in Country Lane. Several tenants just put their old couches out on the curb and they sit there for weeks.

I want the city to let tenants schedule pickups directly through the 311 app.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Bulky pickup policy

item_title: Rezoning application: Blossom Hill Road retail parcel
text:
Dear Council Office,

The bulky pickup came two weeks late and someone had already picked through the pile. I rent an apartment near Blossom Hill Road and Harvard Drive.

Please shorten the wait time for bulky pickups.

[name removed]
subject: Late pickup

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The trash cans near the playground are overflowing by Monday every week, and the wind blows the bags across the grass. We live near the corner of Pinewood Drive and Moorpark Avenue. Parents have started bringing their own bags to haul trash out.

Please add pickups on weekends so these cans get emptied before the week starts.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Cans overflowing near the playground

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

Please prioritize our wall so it does not come back.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Graffiti on our wall

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Thornhaven Way and Knightshaven Way. The public cans on our block fill up by Friday and nobody empties them until Monday. The garbage smell gets bad in the summer and the bugs come out.

I want the city to add a weekend emptying schedule for these cans.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Trash cans full by Friday

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The dump days are held on weekdays when I am at work, and the drop-off sites are an hour away by bus. I have a truck and a pile of old fencing, but I cannot take a day off just to make the drop-off window. Other families in our area are dumping things illegally because they do not have another option.

Please add a weekend dump day closer to us.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Dump days are too far

Regards,

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Cámaras en el callejón

Pakisuri po ang ruta ng trak at tiyaking makukuha ang basura sa takdang araw.

subject: Trash cans and missed pickup

Mong thành phố dùng loại sơn bền hơn và xử lý nhanh hơn khi có báo cáo.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Vẽ bậy trên tường

Cảm ơn quý vị,

Please fund trees and an air filter program for the schools near the freeway.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Asthma near the freeway

Hola,

El ruido de los camiones de la autopista no me deja dormir, sobre todo los que pasan de madrugada. Vivo cerca de Woosley Drive y Felder Drive. Mis nietos ya no quieren dormir en el cuarto de atrás porque se oye demasiado.

Pido que pongan una barda de contención de sonido en nuestra cuadra.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Ruido de la autopista

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Mong thành phố tưới nước hoặc quét đường thường xuyên ở khu này.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Bụi từ xe tải

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Irwindale Dr y Aborn Rd desde hace 12 años. Hay humo de una quema cerca de la autopista y me arden los ojos otra vez.

Por favor avisen cuando la calidad del aire esté mala para quedarnos adentro.

[name removed]
subject: Humo cerca de la autopista

text:
Dear Council Office,

The wall of trees that used to block the freeway dust was cut down, and now the wind blows grit onto our porch. We used to sweep it up twice a week and now it is every day.

I want the city to plant new trees and set up a buffer along the freeway edge.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Trees along the freeway

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

My daughter's school is right beside the freeway, and the windows there are old and the air coming in is full of dust and exhaust. The classroom air purifier they got last year broke and nobody has replaced it. She comes home with a cough almost every week in the fall.

I support adding air filters and upgraded windows at schools next to the freeway.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Air filters for schools

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Hay mucho polvo de los camiones y se mete por las ventanas de mi departamento. Vivo cerca de Cooper River Drive y Fitchville Avenue.

Por favor limpien las calles de esa zona más seguido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Polvo de la carretera

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

[name removed]
subject: Usok at ingay

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Sound wall please

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Dust hurting our shop

[name removed]
subject: Khói từ đường cao tốc

text:

Diesel exhaust from the trucks drifts into our bedroom window every night after eleven. I live by Rossotto Drive and Vanderbilt Drive with my family. I wake up with a sore throat, and I have called the city twice about it.

Please look into whether the trucks are routed correctly and whether a filter program is possible.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Diesel smell at night

text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivimos en Umbarger desde hace 16 años. Antes había unos árboles que tapaban el polvo de la autopista y ahora ya no están. Ahora el viento trae arena hasta el porche y tengo que barrer todos los días. Mi suegra tiene problemas de respiración y ya no puede sentarse afuera.

Pido que la ciudad plante árboles nuevos y ponga una franja de protección a lo largo de la orilla.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Árboles junto a la autopista

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

I just want the city to do something about the prices.

[name removed]
subject: Groceries again

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

Please do whatever you can to slow down rent increases for people like us.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Rent keeps going up

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Gas is expensive and my electric bill jumped again, and I am on a fixed income. The car repair last month cost more than my whole grocery budget.

Please help people like me stay ahead of these costs.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Gas and bills

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Castlemont Avenue y Payne Avenue desde hace 3 años. La renta sube cada año y el súper cada mes, ya no alcanza el sueldo.

Pido que la ciudad busque la manera de ayudar a las familias que trabajamos.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Todo está muy caro

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hi,

Daycare for our two kids costs more than my rent, and I cannot get a spot in the subsidized program. I work a night shift and my partner works mornings, so we juggle who watches them every week. Some of my coworkers have quit because they cannot afford childcare anymore.

Please make sure families like ours get a fair chance at affordable childcare.

[name removed]
subject: Childcare costs

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

I hope the council keeps the cost of living in mind when they make decisions.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Property taxes and bills

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Piedmont Road và Salinas Court. Giá thực phẩm và tiền điện mỗi tháng đều tăng, gia đình tôi không còn đủ tiền để dành. Mỗi tháng tôi phải cắt bớt tiền đi chợ để trả hóa đơn điện.

Mong thành phố nghĩ đến người lao động thu nhập thấp khi đưa ra quyết định.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Giá cả tăng quá

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Everything costs more every month, and nobody seems to care about people who are working hard. My family and I live in Norwood.

Please keep the working families in mind when you vote.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Tired of paying more

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I drive forty minutes to work and gas alone costs me a fortune every week now. We live just off Harwood Rd near Merrill Dr. I have started skipping the fresh produce just to make the grocery budget stretch.

I wish the city would think harder about how working people are getting squeezed.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Cost of groceries and gas

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo cerca de N Capitol Ave y Gimelli Way. El recibo de luz llegó otra vez más caro y no sé cómo voy a pagarlo este mes. Mi mamá y yo vivimos juntas y la casa es muy vieja, gasta mucho.

Pido que la ciudad nos ayude a entender por qué suben tanto los costos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Recibos de luz

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

We live just off Cherry Ave near Marcia Ave. The cost of everything is rising, from car insurance to a loaf of bread.

Please push for relief for working families.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Costs keep rising

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

We bought our house thirty years ago and the property taxes and insurance keep climbing faster than our pensions. I live at the corner of Silver Leaf Road and Grandwell Way. My wife and I now look at every grocery receipt and argue about whether we can afford the bus pass. Our neighbors on this block are selling and moving away because they just cannot keep up.

I wish the council would focus more on helping longtime residents stay in their homes.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Retired on a budget

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

We live just off S Monroe St near Moorpark Ave. Our grocery bill went up almost a hundred dollars a month, and the price of rice and eggs keeps creeping up. I used to meal plan once a week and now I am doing it every three days.

I just hope the city is paying attention to what working families are dealing with.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Everything costs more

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Greymont Dr và Vistapark Dr. Tiền nhà tăng lên một lần nữa và tôi không biết còn ở được bao lâu.

Mong thành phố quan tâm đến người thuê nhà như chúng tôi.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Tiền nhà

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Ocala Ave and Ridgemont Dr. Our rent is going up again next month and I got the letter yesterday.

Please think about renters before the next rent decision.

[name removed]
subject: Rent increase letter

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I opened my bills this morning and I had to sit down for a minute. Half of it is for the car insurance and the other half is for the phone and internet we cannot cut. I keep telling myself it will get better but it has not in three years.

Please take the cost of living seriously in the next budget.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Bills and taxes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I've been a homeowner near Glen Angus Way and Tully Rd for 27 years. The senior lunch program closes too early and I cannot make it there after my doctor visits.

Please extend the meal hours on Fridays.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Senior lunch hours

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

My mother needs rides to her dialysis appointments and the paratransit line keeps saying no. I've lived in Willowmont since 2004. Our family takes turns driving her but we all work full days.

Please add more paratransit capacity for seniors going to medical appointments.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Rides to appointments

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I've been a homeowner near Huran Dr and Harbor View Ave for 7 years. I live alone now and I rarely talk to anyone during the week.

Please think about older residents who are isolated.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Lonely at home

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I've been a homeowner near Yerba Buena Road and Altia Avenue for 16 years. The meal delivery I depend on only comes on weekdays and my weekends are very long. I skipped dinner two Saturdays last month because the food ran out.

Please ask the program to add weekend deliveries for seniors who live alone.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Weekend meals

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Bermuda Way y Ocala Avenue. Mi mamá recibe la comida del programa de adultos mayores solo entre semana y los fines de semana se queda sin comer. Ella no puede manejar y los vecinos no siempre están en casa.

Pido que el programa incluya entregas los sábados y domingos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Comidas para adultos mayores

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

We live just off Fairway Glen Ln near Santa Teresa Blvd. The senior center near the apartments we rent has been closed on Thursdays for months, and nobody says when it will open again. Half the people who used to come now just sit in their rooms all day. I am worried about my neighbors, and I do not know who to ask about it.

Please give us a clear date for when the Thursday hours will return.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Senior center closed

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I do not drive anymore and the clinic is across town with no direct bus. I live at the corner of Gurdwara Ave and Chaboya Rd.

Please look into a volunteer driver program for older residents.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Clinic ride

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Trailside Ln và Trestlewood Dr. Mẹ tôi lớn tuổi, không lái xe được nên cần người chở đi khám bệnh mỗi tuần. Gia đình tôi đều đi làm nên thường không sắp xếp kịp.

Mong thành phố có chương trình đưa đón người cao tuổi đi khám bệnh.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Người già cần chở đi khám

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The lunch site for seniors only takes reservations by phone and the line is always busy. I've lived in Dentwood since 2010.

Please allow walk-in signups for older adults at the lunch program.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Meal program hours

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

My husband passed earlier this year, and I have not found anything to do during the day since then. My family and I live in McKean. The church group stopped meeting and the senior center's classes are full.

I hope the city can add more low-cost activities for widows and widowers.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Lonely after my husband passed

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

The reduced fare card for seniors is hard to renew, and I missed the deadline last time.

Please make the renewal available online for older adults.

[name removed]
subject: Senior bus pass

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I am the only one who takes care of my dad and I am running out of ideas for respite help. I live at the corner of Gurdwara Avenue and John Sorci Drive.

Please share more respite care options for family caregivers.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Caregiver tired

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I got laid off last week and I have no idea how I will cover next month's rent.

Please tell me where to get emergency rent help.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Lost my job

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hi,

I live in Mount Pleasant Foothills. I fell two months behind on rent after my hours got cut, and my landlord has started sending notices. I have been applying for jobs every day but nothing has come through yet.

Please tell me what programs are open for renters who are behind right now.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Behind on rent

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Me llegó una factura del hospital por más de cinco mil dólares y no sé cómo pagarla. Vivo cerca de Ocala Ave y Darwin Way. Solo trabajo medio tiempo desde que me operaron y ya no alcanza.

Por favor díganme a qué programas de ayuda para gastos médicos puedo aplicar.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Gastos del hospital

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

My medical bills from the surgery are piling up and the collection calls started this week. Our family has been in Berryessa Crossing for 9 years.

Please point me to any city program that helps with hospital debt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Medical bills

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

Our family has been in Silver Leaf for 7 years. I may have to close my small repair shop after my biggest client moved away and the rent stayed the same. I have been paying my two employees out of savings and that money is almost gone.

Please tell small business owners like me where to get emergency loans or grants.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Closing the shop

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

We live near the corner of Pullman Way and Daylight Way. My hours were cut in half this month, and I am behind on the electric bill and the car payment. I pick up extra shifts when I can, but the schedule changes every week and I cannot plan childcare.

Please let me know which assistance programs are still taking applications this fall.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Hours cut at work

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Our food truck has not had enough customers for three months and I am paying the loan from my own pocket. I own a small business near Aborn Rd and Bradbury Dr.

Please share any help available for small food businesses.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Restaurant slow season

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

A big contract I was counting on fell through, and I am now behind on payroll for my two part-time workers. I do not want to lay them off but I may not have a choice next month.

I would like the city to tell me about any bridge loans or fee waivers for small businesses.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Lost my contract

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live at the corner of South 15th Street and East San Antonio Street. Rent is due Friday and I only have half of it, so I am asking what I can do.

Please tell me who to call for rent assistance before the late fee hits.

[name removed]
subject: Rent due Friday

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I live at the corner of South Kiely Boulevard and Norwalk Drive. The ER bill from last spring is still unpaid, and now my car needs repairs to get to my new job. Using the bus adds two hours a day, which I cannot afford either.

Please tell me whether there is a hospital charity program I can apply to.

[name removed]
subject: Medical bills and a car

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
We live near the corner of Jackson Street and North 13th Street. I was laid off after nine years at the same place, and I do not have enough savings to last more than a few weeks.

Please tell me what the city offers for displaced workers who need housing help.

[name removed]
subject: Laid off, no savings

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I am two months behind on water and power, and the shutoff notice came in the mail today.

Please tell me where to apply for utility bill help.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Behind on utilities

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

Three cars on our block were broken into last month and nobody came out for the report until the next afternoon. We have called the non-emergency line about the same corner several times and each time the wait got longer.

Please fund enough patrol officers that a break-in report gets a real response the same day.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Car break-ins on my block

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I waited almost three hours for an officer after someone smashed my car window in the carport.

Please make sure the council funds more officers so response times come down.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Slow response

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Someone cut the catalytic converter off our minivan in the driveway overnight, and the repair bill came to over two thousand dollars.

Please put more patrol attention on overnight catalytic converter thefts in residential streets.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Catalytic converter theft

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Every weekend after midnight cars race down the boulevard past our apartment and the noise wakes up the whole building. I live by Boxleaf Court and Judro Way with my family.

Please send patrols to enforce street racing at night and add speed humps where needed.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Street racing at night

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En mi cuadra han roto la ventana de tres carros en los últimos dos meses y nadie ha venido a tomar el reporte. Mi vecina esperó casi todo el día para que alguien llegara, y ya ni quiere llamar.

Les pido que pongan más oficiales en patrullaje para que los robos se atiendan rápido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Robos de carros

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Illegal fireworks go off every night in the week before the holiday and I can't sleep with my baby.

Please step up enforcement on illegal fireworks so families can get some rest.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Fireworks

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Customers keep leaving cars in our lot overnight and two of them have had catalytic converters cut off this year. We already added lighting and a fence, but the police said they cannot patrol the lot itself.

Please assign more patrols to commercial lots at night so customers feel safe leaving their cars.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Customer cars in our lot

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi sống ở khu Mount Pleasant Foothills đã 5 năm. Trong tháng này xe của gia đình tôi bị đập kính hai lần ngay trong con hẻm trước nhà. Tôi đã gọi số không khẩn cấp nhưng phải chờ hơn bốn tiếng, và cảnh sát chỉ ghi biên bản rồi về.

Xin thành phố tăng thêm cảnh sát tuần tra ban đêm ở khu nhà chúng tôi.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Trộm xe

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Council Office,

We live near the corner of Sequoia Avenue and Hanchett Avenue. We waited close to four hours for an officer after a man broke into our neighbor's garage.

Please fund faster patrol coverage so these calls are not left sitting for hours.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Waited hours

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I think the budget should fund more patrol officers, because right now a report can sit for a whole shift. My husband works nights and came home to find the tailgate of his truck pried open, and nobody came until morning. We are tired of paying taxes and getting this kind of response.

Please keep the officer hiring money in the budget and report back on how it will shorten response times.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Officer funding in the budget

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

En el complejo donde vivo se han robado varios carros este año y la policía casi nunca pasa por la noche. Mi esposo maneja de noche y dice que no ha visto ni una patrulla en semanas.

Les pido que aumenten las patrullas nocturnas y que el presupuesto apoye más oficiales.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Falta de patrullas

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
To the City Council,

I do not think the city should keep adding to the police budget when the response times are already this bad. I live by Union Avenue and Rosswood Drive with my family. The problem in my view is how the department is run, and that should be looked at before any new hires.

Please vote against the new officer hiring line until there is an audit of how the department spends its money.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Against more officer money

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Fireworks went off in the street until two in the morning again, and our dog hid under the bed all night.

Please send an officer to fireworks complaints quickly, because by the time anyone comes they are gone.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Fireworks again

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dalawang beses nang sinira ang bintana ng kotse namin sa harap ng bahay ngayong taon. Tumawag na kami sa hindi emergency na numero pero hindi pa rin dumating ang pulis hanggang kinabukasan.

Sana po ay dagdagan ng konseho ang bilang ng pulis na nagro-roonda sa gabi.

[name removed]
subject: Nakaw ng sasakyan

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
I rent an apartment near Quimby Road and Edgebank Drive. My car was broken into twice in one month in our apartment lot and the police only came out once, after I called three times.

Please prioritize repeat car break-in reports in the next budget and patrol plan.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Break-ins in our lot

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

Every Saturday night a group of cars does burnouts at the end of our cul-de-sac, and the smoke gets into our house. I live near Terra Bella Avenue and Lincoln Avenue.

Please assign enforcement to sideshows and street racing in our area as a recurring problem.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Sideshow noise

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Someone broke into our delivery van in the lot overnight and took the handheld scanners and a case of tools. I run a shop near the corner of Woosley Dr and Sautner Dr. That van is our only one, so we lost three days of deliveries while the window was replaced.

Please dedicate more patrols to commercial lots at night, since we pay taxes like everyone else.

[name removed]
subject: Delivery van break-in

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Los fuegos artificiales ilegales truenan hasta la madrugada y ya llamé varias veces sin que llegue nadie. Vivo en La Vey.

Les pido que pongan más oficiales en esta zona para parar los fuegos artificiales.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Patrullas

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I support the proposal to add more patrol officers in the budget, because our block watch has done what it can and we still get break-ins. We live just off Hillsdale Avenue near Dow Drive. Most of us are renters who cannot afford private cameras, so we rely on the city.

Please approve the officer hiring line as proposed and track response times on a public dashboard.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Support the officer proposal

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Pháo nổ bất hợp pháp suốt đêm trước Tết và trẻ nhỏ trong nhà tôi sợ hãi, khóc không ngừng.

Xin thành phố tăng cường xử phạt pháo nổ để các gia đình được yên ổn.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Pháo nổ

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I oppose the proposal to move patrol money into a new unit, because our street still waits hours for an officer.

Please vote no on that transfer until the department shows how response times will change.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Oppose moving patrol money

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

We've lived in Mount Pleasant for 20 years. The police are talking about adding staff, but on my street they have not come by once this year, even though the cars keep getting broken into. I have a list of the incident numbers if anyone wants them.

Please show us how many officers are actually assigned to our district before approving more money.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Who is actually assigned

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hola,

Vivo en Spanish Cove. Tengo una tienda de reparación de llantas y dos veces este año me robaron las herramientas de la parte de atrás. La policía tardó más de dos horas en venir ambas veces y después ya no quise llamar.

Les pido que pongan más patrullas en las zonas comerciales por la noche.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Negocio y robos

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Nobody has come out to our complex in months, even though car windows keep getting smashed. We live near the corner of Nazarene Way and Williams Road.

Please fund more night patrols for our complex.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: No patrols

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
To the City Council,

We live just off Kirk Road near Foxworthy Avenue. I am against spending more on officers when we have not seen results from the current patrols on our street. My kids are scared of the crime, but I think money for after-school programs would do more than another round of hiring.

Please redirect new public safety money to youth and prevention programs instead of new hires.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Prevention over hiring

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
When my brother was in a mental health crisis last spring, the only option was calling police, and it turned into a scary situation for everyone. I live at the corner of Duvall Dr and Hamilton Ave.

Please fund a crisis response team of mental health workers who can respond without officers for calls like this.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Crisis team

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hi,

There is a man who sleeps near our apartment entrance and he is clearly having a breakdown most nights, but nobody comes who knows how to help him.

Please send mental health outreach workers instead of police for calls like this.

[name removed]
subject: Man on the sidewalk

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Mi vecino que vive en la calle empezó a gritar y a empujar a la gente en la cuadra, y la policía llegó con las luces prendidas y lo asustó más. Vivo en Warner Heights. Creo que alguien que sepa de salud mental debió venir primero, porque él estaba muy enfermo y no era un criminal.

Les pido que el presupuesto financie equipos de salud mental que respondan sin policías en llamadas como esta.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Crisis de salud mental

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I think trained civilians should handle mental health crises instead of officers, because officers are not trained for them and it often goes badly. We live near the corner of Curie Dr and Galen Dr. My neighbor's son was taken to jail after a psychotic episode and released a week later with no treatment. The city already runs other social programs, so it can run this one too.

Please fund a civilian crisis response program with clinicians and peer support workers and report on the first year.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Civilian responders

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I am not sure trained civilians can handle a crisis when someone has a weapon, so I would rather have officers stay part of the response. That is the situation I keep worrying about, especially with my kids walking home past the bus stop.

Please keep officers in the lead on crisis calls and do not replace them with a pilot program until it is proven.

[name removed]
subject: Doubts a civilian team

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our block has a woman who yells at cars at night and I am worried she will get hurt, but calling police feels like making it worse. Our family has been in McKean for 20 years.

Please create a daytime outreach team that can check on people like her before a crisis happens.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Unhoused neighbor

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Ở khu tôi có một người đàn ông vô gia cư bị khủng hoảng tinh thần, ông hay la hét giữa đường vào ban đêm. Gia đình tôi ở gần Canoas Garden Ave và Almaden Expy. Cảnh sát đến rồi đi, không ai biết cách giúp ông ấy, và tôi rất lo cho sức khỏe của ông.

Xin thành phố đưa nhân viên tâm thần đến hỗ trợ thay vì chỉ có cảnh sát.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Người vô gia cư

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

I run a shop near the corner of Meridian Avenue and Patio Drive. Our coffee shop keeps getting customers in crisis who need help, and we are not trained for that. Last month a customer had a psychotic episode at the counter and I had to call police, which I hate doing.

Please fund a mental health responder program that businesses can call instead of the police.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Customers in crisis

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I've been a homeowner near Red Maple Way and Trailside Lane for 27 years. I oppose the proposed civilian crisis pilot because I don't trust that a new program will show up on time with enough staff at night.

Please vote no on the pilot until the city shows funded staffing and a training plan.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Opposing civilian pilot

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Vivo en Dove Hill. Cuando mi mamá tuvo una crisis en casa, llamamos y tardaron horas, y nadie sabía cómo calmarla.

Les pido que pongan un equipo de crisis que sepa manejar estas situaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Llamadas de crisis

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Council Office,

Our neighbor who is unhoused gets moved along by police every few weeks and returns to the same corner within a day.

Please coordinate outreach so people get connected to services rather than just moved along.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Tired of the loop

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I think the city should hire more crisis counselors who work alongside police, so people do not end up in jail for having a bad day. My landlord called police on a tenant who was having a panic attack, and the situation got much worse. A counselor would have done better.

Please add crisis counselor positions to the public safety budget and report on how many calls they handle.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Crisis counselors

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

We live near the corner of Farnsworth Dr and Silver Ridge Dr. Please stop sending officers to every mental health call, because half the time the officer is not what the person needs.

Send someone trained for this kind of call first and call police only if needed.

[name removed]
subject: Send someone trained

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
我住的地方附近有一位无家可归的人经常情绪失控，大声喊叫，有时候还会在路边摔东西。 我担心他会受伤，附近的孩子看到也会害怕，但叫警察又怕把事情弄得更糟。

希望市政府能派受过训练的心理危机人员去协助，而不是只派警察。

[name removed]
subject: 心理危机

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I rent an apartment near Pacheco Dr and N Jackson Ave. Someone in our building has been having episodes in the stairwell for months, and the ambulance comes but the only follow-up is a ride to the emergency room. Our building manager has asked for help several times, but nothing has changed.

Please fund a follow-up team that connects people in crisis to a bed or a clinic after an emergency response.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Follow-up after crisis calls

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
I support using license plate readers on the main roads if they help catch the people who keep stealing catalytic converters from our cars. I would rather have a camera on the corner than an officer that never comes, and I accept some tracking for that.

Please approve the license plate reader pilot and publish the rules on how long the data is kept.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Cameras for safety

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hi,

I oppose license plate readers because they record where everyone drives, and I do not think a few stolen parts justify a database of our movements. I live near Cherry Ave and Joplin Dr. Immigrant neighbors in my building already avoid going out after dark, and I don't want them to feel watched by their own city. Any data kept should be deleted quickly and never shared with other agencies.

Please vote against the plate reader contract unless there is a strict limit on data retention and sharing.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Privacy concern about readers

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Estoy de acuerdo con poner cámaras en las calles principales si de verdad ayudan a encontrar a los que roban carros. Vivimos en Gimelli-Delano Manongs desde hace 7 años. Prefiero que haya una cámara que vigile la esquina a que nadie venga cuando hay un robo.

Les pido que aprueben el programa de cámaras y que digan cuánto tiempo guardan las grabaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Cámaras en la calle

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

No quiero que nos vigilen con cámaras que leen las placas de nuestros carros, porque mucha gente aquí tiene miedo de ser rastreada.

Les pido que no compren ese sistema sin garantías de que la información no se comparta con nadie.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: No quiero que nos vigilen

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

We have had cameras on our corner for two years and they helped solve a hit and run.

Please keep the current camera program and expand it to the blocks where thefts are most common.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Cameras on corners

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

As a business owner I use cameras on my lot, but I am not sure a city-run plate reader adds much beyond what private systems already do. I own a small business near Diamond Ave and Torrance Ave. It seems like the money would be better spent on lighting and patrols at night than on a database that nobody reviews.

Please ask for an independent review of plate readers before the city signs any contract.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Store cameras and readers

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Verona Road and Yerba Buena Road. I think city cameras in parks are an overreach, because they are going up where kids play and nobody asked us.

Please require a public hearing before any new camera is installed in a park or on a school route.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Overreach concern

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Sa tingin ko makakatulong ang mga camera sa kalsada para mahuli ang mga magnanakaw ng sasakyan sa aming lugar. Pero sana may malinaw na patakaran kung gaano katagal itatago ang mga video at sino ang makakakita nito.

Sana po ay magkaroon muna ng pampublikong pagdinig bago pumasok ang mga bagong camera sa aming kalye.

[name removed]
subject: Mga camera sa kalsada

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I do not see how a camera on the corner stops a break-in when the police never show up.

Please put the camera money toward patrol staffing instead.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Camera money

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Trinidad Drive và Jeremie Drive. Tôi đồng ý lắp camera ở các góc đường đông người qua lại vì nhiều xe máy bị trộm. Nhưng tôi mong thành phố công khai ai được xem các đoạn video và trong bao lâu thì xóa.

Xin hội đồng thành phố thông qua chương trình camera với quy định rõ ràng về việc lưu trữ dữ liệu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Camera ở khu phố

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Scanning every car that drives past our house feels like the city is tracking us for no good reason.

Please do not approve plate readers on residential streets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Scanning everyone

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

En mi cuadra ya hay cámaras de vecinos y no me molesta, pero no quiero que la ciudad guarde los videos durante años. Mi hijo trabaja en el turno de noche y lo último que quiero es que sus horarios queden en una base de datos.

Les pido que pongan un límite claro de cuántos días se guardan las grabaciones antes de aprobar algo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Cámaras y privacidad

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

Put the after-school program money back in the budget, because my son has nothing to do after school except hang around the corner store. I live near Montgomery Ln and Gerdts Dr. A few of his friends got picked up by police last winter for loitering, which made everyone's parents nervous.

Please keep the after-school program money in the budget and add late-night weekend hours.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: After-school money

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I rent an apartment near Vernice Avenue and Griffith Street. Summer jobs for teens ran out before I could sign up my daughter, and she spent the whole summer at home.

Please fund more summer job slots for young people and open the applications earlier.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Summer jobs

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live at the corner of Grey Ghost Avenue and Edenview Drive. The lights on the path to the playground have been out for six months, and it is too dark for kids to walk home after practice.

Please repair the path lighting and add it to the next capital improvement list.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Path lights

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Plumstead Way y Nieman Boulevard desde hace 12 años. Mis hijos salen de la escuela a las tres y no tienen dónde estar hasta que yo llego del trabajo a las seis. Hay un programa de tarea que cerró el año pasado y no lo han vuelto a abrir.

Les pido que financien un programa de tarea y actividades después de clases en nuestra zona.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Clases después de la escuela

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Our city gym closes at nine and teens have nowhere to go on Friday nights, so they end up in the parking lots. I've lived in Farnham since 1999.

Please keep the gym open late on weekends as a funded pilot.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Late night gym

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hi,

I oppose the cut to youth programs in next year's budget, because these programs cost less than police overtime. A summer program kept my nephew off the streets, and I have seen the difference firsthand.

Please restore the youth program funding before the budget is final.

[name removed]
subject: Restore youth funding

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Xin chào,

Con trai tôi ở nhà một mình đến tối vì không có chỗ nào cho các em sinh hoạt sau giờ học. Tôi mong thành phố mở lại lớp học thêm miễn phí vào mùa hè như mấy năm trước.

Xin thành phố tiếp tục tài trợ các chương trình sinh hoạt cho thanh thiếu niên sau giờ học.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Chương trình thiếu niên

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I think the money should go to youth programs rather than patrols, because the teen center closed and the kids in my building have nowhere to go. My daughter is thirteen and spends the nights alone, and I work doubles so I cannot be there. Programs that keep her busy would do more than any patrol car on our street.

Please move part of the proposed patrol increase into late-night youth programs in the next budget.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Youth over patrol

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My house is right at Seven Trees Boulevard and Rancho Drive. The city cut evening hours at the rec field this summer, so the kids who used to play soccer until dark are back on the street. The sign-up fees went up to cover rentals, and most families cannot afford it.

Please restore the evening recreation hours and cover the costs with the existing youth budget.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Rec field evenings

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I run a small landscaping business and I want to hire teens this summer, but the youth job placement paperwork is too slow. I run a shop near the corner of Bryan Avenue and Cherry Avenue. Two of the teens I interviewed had to drop out because the paperwork took six weeks.

Please fast-track the summer youth job placement process for local small businesses.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Hiring teens

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live by Desmet Dr and Brunetti Dr with my family. Kids walking home from the library after dark have to cross a dark lot, and I'm worried about them every night.

Please add lighting and a late bus route to help kids get home safely.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Walking home

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Los muchachos de la cuadra andan en la calle hasta la madrugada porque no hay nada para ellos, y ya hubo una pelea grande. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Saddle Brook Dr y Canyon Trail Way desde hace 9 años. Yo sé que la mayoría son buenos chicos, pero les falta algo que hacer.

Les pido que pongan un programa nocturno de deportes o clases para los jóvenes.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Muchachos en la calle

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Mi hija quería un trabajo de verano y no pudo entrar en el programa porque se llenó en dos días.

Les pido que abran más plazas de trabajo de verano para jóvenes el próximo año.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Verano sin trabajo

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Ở chung cư tôi, các em học sinh cấp hai không có chỗ học bài hay chơi sau giờ học nên cả tuần chỉ quanh quẩn ở sân. Tôi sống gần Chaboya Road và Gurdwara Avenue. Mẹ tôi giữ bé ở nhà còn tôi phải đi làm ca tối, nên không ai để ý con em họ. Tôi mong thành phố mở một phòng sinh hoạt có người lớn trông coi vào buổi tối.

Xin thành phố mở chương trình sinh hoạt tối cho thiếu niên trong năm tới.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Thanh niên không có chỗ đi

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
放学以后孩子没有地方去，晚上只能在街上闲逛，我很担心他们的安全。

希望市政府能增加夜间青少年活动项目，让孩子们有地方去。

[name removed]
subject: 孩子放学后

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hi,

I support the budget item for youth mentorship, because a mentor on my son's team made a bigger difference than any patrol car could. I've lived in Baker West since 2015. Our city has a mentorship program that works, but it only has room for a few kids each year.

Please keep youth mentorship funding in the budget and open it to more kids in our area.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Mentorship funding

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hello,

I live near E Empire St and N 13th St. The lights at the basketball courts shut off at nine, and kids who would be shooting hoops end up at the bus shelter with nothing to do. Parents in my building asked to keep them on until ten on weekends, and the request has been sitting for months.

Please keep the court lights on until ten on weekends as a low-cost fix.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Court lights

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live at the corner of Hillsdale Avenue and Summercreek Drive. I oppose adding more police money this year, because the youth programs got cut and those kids are the ones getting into trouble. We have seen more kids on the street since the community pool closed for repairs and never reopened. Give the money to after-school staff and counselors and see what changes in a year.

Please vote no on the next officer hiring increase and move that money to youth programs.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Priorities this year

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

I support limiting how much local police work with federal immigration agents, because my neighbors stop calling for help when they fear a knock at the door. I live at the corner of Newhall St and Sherwood Ave. Two families on our street have already moved out after rumors that agents were in the area.

Please pass the ordinance that keeps local officers out of civil immigration enforcement.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Support limits on cooperation

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I rent an apartment near Gurdwara Avenue and John Sorci Drive. My mother won't call police anymore, even when someone breaks into the building, because she thinks they will check her papers.

Please limit police cooperation with federal agents so people feel safe reporting crimes.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Scared to call

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Mi familia tiene miedo de llamar a la policía desde que se corrió el rumor de que agentes federales andan por el barrio. Mi esposo maneja para trabajar y ya no quiere que salgamos a comprar nada de noche.

Les pido que la policía local no ayude con redadas de inmigración y que lo dejen por escrito.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Miedo de llamar

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Hello,

I run a restaurant and some of my cooks have stopped coming in because they are scared of being stopped on the way. I own a small business near Princess Anne Dr and Lynnhaven Dr.

Please adopt a policy limiting local police involvement in immigration enforcement.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Staff afraid to come in

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
To the City Council,

I oppose limiting police cooperation with federal agents, because if someone is a criminal the police should be able to work with whoever can help.

Please vote no on any policy that restricts officers from sharing information with federal partners.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Against the sanctuary idea

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
Dear Council Office,

I oppose a blanket ban on working with federal partners, since the police need to be able to act on serious crimes in our area. I do not want neighbors harassed, but a blanket rule could block investigations into the robberies we keep having. A narrow rule that targets civil immigration checks would make more sense to me.

Please vote against a blanket ban and support narrower limits instead.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Both sides of the rule

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Hanchett Ave y Sequoia Ave. Yo creo que la ciudad debe proteger a las familias inmigrantes, porque muchas tienen niños que van a la escuela y no quieren ver a la policía. Mi vecina dejó de mandar a su hija a la clase de música por miedo a que la detuvieran afuera. Eso no debe pasar en nuestra ciudad.

Les pido que aprueben un límite a la cooperación de la policía con agentes federales de inmigración.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Proteger a las familias

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
I am not sure what the right balance is, but I want the council to be clear about when local officers help with immigration arrests. Right now people hear different things from different officers, and that creates fear.

Please publish a written policy that spells out when local police can assist federal immigration agents.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Write the rule down

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi là người nhập cư, và chúng tôi rất sợ mỗi khi nghe tin cảnh sát hợp tác với đặc vụ liên bang. Tôi sống ở khu Cadwallader. Con gái tôi không dám đi học một mình vì sợ bị hỏi giấy tờ, dù con không làm gì sai.

Xin hội đồng thành phố hạn chế việc cảnh sát địa phương hỗ trợ đặc vụ liên bang bắt giữ người nhập cư.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Người nhập cư sợ hãi

item_title: Public safety budget: patrols, community service officers, cameras
text:
To the City Council,

I want the city to make it a rule that local officers do not join immigration sweeps in our area.

Please pass a sweeps ban for local police so families are not caught up in federal operations.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Sweeps ban

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Một người bạn ở chung cư của tôi nhận được một lá thư có con dấu liên bang và không dám nói chuyện với cảnh sát khi xe bị trộm. Chị ấy vẫn chưa trình báo, và tôi nói chị ấy phải được trình báo mà không sợ hãi.

Xin thành phố bảo đảm cảnh sát địa phương không hỏi về tình trạng nhập cư khi nhận tin báo.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Sợ đi trình báo

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivimos en Berryessa Creek desde hace 5 años. Tengo una empresa de jardinería con trabajadores inmigrantes y el mes pasado una de nuestras camionetas la detuvieron en un retén cerca de la carretera. Ese día perdimos un día completo de trabajo y uno de mis muchachos ya no quiere regresar.

Les pido que aprueben una norma local que mantenga a la policía fuera de las redadas de inmigración.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Cuadrilla de trabajo

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I oppose a sanctuary policy that tells local officers to refuse federal requests, because it leaves our street exposed to people who should be arrested. I live by Woosley Drive and Felder Drive with my family. Our block had a stolen car ring last year, and the federal task force was the only thing that helped us find them. I would not want that tool removed.

Please vote against the sanctuary resolution unless it keeps cooperation on serious criminal cases.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Against the sanctuary resolution

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Cuando llamamos a la policía por un robo, lo primero que preguntan los oficiales es si tenemos papeles. Vivo cerca de Yerba Buena Road y Fowler Road.

Les pido que la policía de aquí no pregunte por el estatus migratorio al reportar un delito.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Preguntas de papeles

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

We've lived in Willowmont for 3 years. I want the council to hold a public hearing on the policy before any vote, since the first draft was written without anyone from our community. Immigrant business owners on my street weren't invited to the first meeting, and I think that's a problem.

Please schedule a public hearing on the sanctuary draft with interpretation in several languages.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Hold a hearing

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

My house is right at Piedmont Road and Majestic Way. The commission meetings are always at two in the afternoon on weekdays, so the people who actually live with the problems never get to speak. I work a shift until four, and by the time I could get there the agenda would be over.

Please move at least some commission meetings to evenings or weekends so working families can attend.

[name removed]
subject: Meeting times

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

Every time the council fills a commission seat it seems to go to someone who has already donated to a campaign.

Please publish the applicant list and donor disclosures before any appointment vote.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Appointments

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Las reuniones de las comisiones son entre semana por la tarde y yo trabajo en la construcción, así que nunca puedo ir a hablar. Mi esposa tampoco puede faltar a su trabajo y nadie nos avisó que había intérprete en español.

Les pido que pongan intérpretes en las reuniones y que las hagan en horario de noche.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Juntas de la ciudad

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
As a small business owner, I'd like to see at least one seat on each commission filled by someone who runs a shop on the older commercial strip. The current members are mostly from large developers and big firms, and small shops keep getting left out of decisions. Our voices should count too.

Please require that at least one seat on each commission goes to a small business representative.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Commission seats for shops

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

Meetings have no interpreter for Vietnamese, so my parents sit in the back and cannot follow what is happening.

Please provide interpretation in Vietnamese and Spanish at every commission meeting.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Interpreters

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Pearl Avenue và Upton Way. Các buổi họp của ủy ban luôn diễn ra vào buổi chiều giờ hành chính nên người đi làm như tôi không thể tham dự. Tôi muốn phát biểu về vấn đề đường phố nhưng phải xin nghỉ việc, và tôi không đủ tiền để mất một ngày lương.

Xin thành phố tổ chức họp ủy ban vào buổi tối hoặc cuối tuần để người lao động có thể tham gia.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Họp ngoài giờ hành chính

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I've lived in Hyde Park since 1999. Almost everyone appointed to the planning board seems to be a homeowner who has lived in the same place for decades. Many residents rent, but nobody on the board has ever lived in an apartment like mine.

Please appoint a renter and a younger worker to the next open seat on the planning board.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Who gets appointed

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I've lived in Meadowlands since 2004. I support paying a small stipend to commission members so that people who work hourly jobs can still afford to serve. Right now only retirees and people with savings can sit on these boards, and that does not reflect the city. A modest stipend is a small line in the budget compared to the consultants we already pay.

Please add a commission stipend to the next budget and tie it to attendance.

[name removed]
subject: Stipend for commissioners

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

They post the meeting agenda a day before and then vote on things nobody had a chance to read. I live by Evergreen Way and Timberline Dr with my family.

Please post agendas at least a week ahead and include plain-language summaries.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Agendas

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I oppose term limits on commissions, because the people who have done this work for years know what the projects need. Experience matters, but we should also have open seats every year so new people can apply.

Please keep current term lengths and open every seat to public applications at least once a year.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Term limits

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Vivimos en Palmhaven desde hace 27 años. En la comisión de vivienda no hay nadie que viva como nosotros, todos llevan años con casa propia.

Les pido que publiquen las vacantes y acepten solicitudes de cualquier persona de la ciudad.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Vivienda sin nosotros

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Overland Way và Springfield Way. Các thành viên ủy ban đều là người có tiếng tăm, còn những người thường như chúng tôi không biết làm sao để ứng cử.

Xin thành phố công bố cách nộp đơn và tiêu chí chọn người rõ ràng cho mọi người.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Thành viên ủy ban

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I was on a city advisory group that rarely met, and our recommendations went nowhere. They gave us a deadline and then cancelled the meetings twice without notice.

Please require commissions to publish how they responded to each public recommendation.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Advisory group

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

Meetings should be recorded and posted online so people who cannot come still know what was decided. I live in Thousand Oaks. My mom is a caregiver and cannot leave the house in the afternoon, but she follows city news closely on the radio. We should not need to attend in person to hold the council accountable.

Please record every commission meeting and post the video within 48 hours.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Recording meetings

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I cannot bring my toddler to a commission meeting and nobody offers childcare, so I just stay home. Two other parents on my floor gave up on speaking at all for the same reason.

Please provide childcare or a kids' room at commission meetings held in the evening.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Childcare at meetings

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I oppose lowering the voter threshold for local taxes, because a simple majority could raise our property taxes without enough input.

Please keep the two-thirds requirement for local tax measures and do not put a lower threshold on the ballot.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Keep the two-thirds rule

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I support a lower voter threshold for local public safety and parks funding, because the current two-thirds rule keeps good measures from passing.

Please put a majority-vote measure on the ballot for public safety funding.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Lower threshold

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

No estoy de acuerdo con bajar el requisito de votos para aprobar impuestos locales, porque ya pagamos demasiado en la casa. Cada año sube la cuenta de impuestos sin que nadie nos pregunte, y nosotros somos los que pagamos.

Les pido que voten en contra de cualquier medida que baje el requisito de dos tercios.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Impuesto a la propiedad

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I live by Yerba Buena Rd and Altia Ave with my family. I want the council to oppose any local measure that tries to get around the property tax limits that have kept my taxes predictable.

Please take a stand against any local property tax measure that uses a loophole around the state limits.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Oppose workarounds

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Renters pay property taxes through rent, so a higher local tax would hit us too. Landlords have already said they will pass any tax increase straight to tenants.

Please require a rent impact analysis before the council puts a new local tax on the ballot.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Renters and the tax

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I support a new local tax on vacant units owned by large companies, since they are not paying their share.

Please put a vacancy tax measure on the ballot with a simple majority threshold.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Vacancy tax

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi không đồng ý tăng thuế địa phương vì thuế nhà đất ở đây đã cao hơn nhiều năm trước. Gia đình tôi ở gần Alexian Drive và North Jackson Avenue. Gia đình tôi đang dành dụm để trả nợ, và mỗi lần có thông báo tăng thuế là lại lo lắng.

Xin hội đồng bỏ phiếu chống bất kỳ đề xuất nào làm giảm ngưỡng bỏ phiếu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Thuế tài sản

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm in favor of a local tax for affordable housing, but only if voters can approve it with a simple majority. I rent an apartment near Turtlerock Dr and Tobago Ave. Renters feel every rent increase, and nobody in the council has really talked about that. If the money actually brings rent down, I would vote yes.

Please let voters decide an affordable housing tax by simple majority next year.

[name removed]
subject: Affordable housing tax

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

The two-thirds rule is too high for the things we actually need, and it keeps the same few projects stuck for years.

Please support a state-level change that lets cities pass public safety taxes by majority vote.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Majority votes

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
To the City Council,

I am against any tax measure that puts the cost on renters without a rent cap, because that just passes the bill to the people who can least afford it. Our building has already had two rent hikes this year, and the owner says the property taxes are the reason. A rent cap would protect us more than any tax credit.

Please vote no on any ballot tax measure unless it comes with a rent stabilization provision.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Rent stabilization first

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I think vacant council seats should be filled by a special election, because appointments let the council pick its own colleagues without voters. When the last seat opened, the appointment process took months and most of us never heard about the applicants.

Please schedule a special election for the vacant seat rather than appointing a replacement.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Special election

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I rent an apartment near Ciro Avenue and Bailey Avenue. Honestly, appointing someone is faster and saves the city money, and I'd rather have a qualified person in the seat now.

Please appoint a qualified replacement now and skip the cost of a special election.

[name removed]
subject: Appoint and move on

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Creo que cuando se vacía un lugar en el concejo debe haber una elección especial, porque la gente de aquí merece escoger a su representante. Cuando el lugar se llenó sin votación, mucha gente sintió que las decisiones ya estaban hechas. Eso no debe repetirse en nuestra ciudad.

Les pido que pongan la elección especial en la boleta antes de nombrar a alguien.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Elección especial
