item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I run a shop near the corner of Chesbro Avenue and Calero Avenue. As a business owner, I want the appointment process to be published line by line, with each council member's vote and reasons recorded. Right now we hear results after the fact, and it is hard to hold anyone accountable.

Please require that every appointment vote and its reasons be posted online the same day.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Transparency for appointments

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

Before any vote happens, the council should say out loud who it is considering for the seat. I've been a homeowner near Ione Dr and Sierraville Ave for 5 years.

Please hold a public interview for each candidate before the council votes on a replacement.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Name the candidates

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Ghế trống trong hội đồng nên được bầu lại, vì tôi không biết ai được chọn và tại sao. Gia đình tôi sống ở đây đã lâu nhưng chưa bao giờ được hỏi ý kiến về người thay thế.

Xin thành phố tổ chức bầu cử đặc biệt cho ghế trống để người dân có tiếng nói.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Chọn người vào ghế trống

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I oppose a special election for the vacant seat, because a campaign costs too much and turnout would be low anyway. We've lived in Los Paseos for 20 years. Turnout for these off-cycle races is usually a few percent, so a small group would decide who represents the whole district. We would be paying for an election that the council could fill much more cheaply.

Please appoint a qualified interim member this month and save the special election money.

[name removed]
subject: Against a special election

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

The council should not be picking its own replacement, because that is how the same people stay in power for years.

Please put the appointment rules up for public comment before the next vacancy.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Who decides

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We pay council salaries and staff for a reason, and I expect the council to pick the option with the lowest cost to taxpayers. The last vacancy cost several thousand dollars in staff time, and nobody published the breakdown.

Please publish the cost estimate for both the appointment process and any special election.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: What it costs

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

We've lived in San Tomas West for 27 years. I want the council to keep its appointment record open for review, so voters can see how each member voted on the replacement and why. If the decision is hidden behind a closed session, the public loses trust in the process. Most residents I talk to feel the same way.

Please ban closed-session votes on council vacancies.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Closed sessions

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Hello,

The water heater in my apartment has been dead for nine days now. My landlord keeps saying the part is on order. I live near E St James St and N 13th St.

Please send an inspector to check the water heater and cite the owner if it is not fixed.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: No hot water for over a week

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo en Thompson Creek. El calentador de agua de mi departamento no funciona desde hace casi tres semanas. Mi casera dice que va a mandar a alguien, pero nunca llega nadie. Tenemos dos niños pequeños y tenemos que calentar agua en la estufa para bañarlos.

Quisiera que la ciudad mande un inspector y obligue a que reparen el calentador.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Sin agua caliente desde hace semanas

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
The tenant in our back unit called on Monday because the furnace quit and the apartment is down to about 55 degrees. We are a small landlord with one rental, and we did call a heating company, but they cannot come until next week. The tenant has a newborn and asked whether the city can require a faster repair.

Please tell us what the city expects for emergency heat repairs so we can meet the code.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Furnace down in our rental

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hello,

Black mold has spread across the bathroom ceiling and up the wall behind the tub, and the landlord painted over it twice without fixing the leak above it. The unit also has no working heat in the bedroom, so we run a space heater with an extension cord. I rent an apartment near Newhall St and Frankfurt Ave. My son has had a cough since October, and the doctor said the air in our home could be part of it. We have sent three written requests to the management office and have not gotten a repair date.

Please send a housing inspector to the unit to cite the mold, the leak, and the heating problem.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Mold, leak, and no heat

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Trinidad Dr và Akio Way. Máy nước nóng trong căn hộ của tôi đã hỏng từ tuần trước. Chủ nhà hẹn sửa nhưng đến giờ vẫn chưa có ai đến.

Xin thành phố cử thanh tra đến kiểm tra và yêu cầu chủ nhà sửa máy nước nóng.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Không có nước nóng

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

We've lived in Santa Teresa for 7 years. Roaches are coming out of the stove and the cabinet under the sink every night. The exterminator came once in March and the problem came right back.

Please have an inspector look at the unit and require the owner to treat the building properly.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Cockroaches in the kitchen again

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

En mi cuarto hay humedad y manchas negras en la pared desde el invierno pasado. Cada vez que llueve entra agua por la ventana rota y el dueño no la ha arreglado. Mi hija tiene asma y el doctor dice que el moho le empeora la respiración.

Pido que la ciudad revise la humedad y el moho y que se obligue al dueño a repararlo.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Humedad y moho en el cuarto

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

We live just off South Bascom Avenue near Foxworthy Avenue. The back bedroom of my rental house has a window that will not latch, and the lock on the side gate is broken so anyone can walk in.

Please tell me whether a broken gate lock and window latch are code violations I need to fix right away.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Broken gate lock and window latch

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

The upstairs hallway light fixture sparks whenever someone turns it on, and the ceiling near it has a brown water stain that keeps growing. I reported both to the management office last month. I live at the corner of Leeward Dr and Sunnyglen Dr. Nothing has been done, and the stain is now the size of a dinner plate.

Please have an inspector check the wiring and the roof leak above the hallway.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Sparking light and roof leak

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

My front door deadbolt does not lock anymore because the strike plate pulled out of the frame. Anyone can push the door open from outside. I live near Bennett Way and Lincoln Avenue.

Please order the owner to repair the door lock within the code timeline.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Front door lock broken

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Nhà tôi bị rò nước từ trần phòng tắm xuống phòng khách, sàn gỗ bị phồng lên và có mùi ẩm mốc. Tôi đã báo cho quản lý tòa nhà hai lần nhưng họ chỉ lau sàn. Gia đình tôi ở gần Kimberly Dr và Cherry Ave. Con tôi bị dị ứng và phải ngủ ở phòng khác vì mùi quá nặng.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra chỗ rò nước và buộc chủ nhà sửa tận gốc.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Rò nước và ẩm mốc

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hi,

The tenant in unit three reports the boiler has been shutting off for days at a time, and the thermostat in the hall barely responds. I hired a licensed plumber who said the heat exchanger needs replacing, and that job is expensive. My house is right at Sierra Rd and Braebridge Rd. The tenant has a toddler and is asking me to move them to a hotel, which I cannot afford. I want to do this right, so I am asking what permit and inspection steps apply before I start the replacement.

Please tell me what permit and inspection the city requires for a boiler replacement in a rental.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Boiler failure in a rental unit

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo en Umbarger. La estufa de mi casa no prende y el cuarto se pone muy frío por las noches. Ya llamé al dueño dos veces y no vino nadie.

Necesito que la ciudad mande un inspector a revisar la calefacción.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Calefacción rota en casa

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hi,

The shower only runs cold, and when I asked for a fix the landlord sent a handyman who just tightened the knob. The grout behind the tub is also cracked enough that water seeps into the wall. My kids have to shower at my sister's place on weekends.

Please send an inspector to check the water supply and the wall damage in my unit.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Cold shower and cracked wall

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

The window in my bedroom has a crack that lets in cold air, and the frame is rotting at the bottom.

Please require the owner to replace the window before winter.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Cracked bedroom window

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
我租住的公寓热水器已经坏了两个星期，房东一直说会派人来修，但到现在也没有人来。冬天洗澡只能用冷水，老人和孩子都很难受。 我们已经用微信和书面信件通知过房东三次。

希望城市派检查员来检查，并要求房东尽快修好热水器。

[name removed]
subject: 热水器长期不能用

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

There is a dead rat smell in the crawlspace under my unit, and the building has droppings by the back door. I live at the corner of Downing Avenue and Rickenbacker Street.

Please send an inspector to check for rodents and require the owner to seal the entry points.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Rodent smell under the unit

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

Water is coming through the shared wall from the unit next door, and my kitchen ceiling bubbled up last month. The neighbor's unit is a rental and the owner is not answering calls. I had a plumber look at my side, and he says the leak is definitely coming from the other side of the wall.

Please have an inspector visit the neighboring unit and order the owner to fix the leak.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Neighbor's leak through shared wall

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Buenas tardes,

Desde que empezó la temporada de lluvias, el techo del baño tiene goteras y el moho ya llega hasta la cama de mi hijo. El dueño pintó encima sin reparar nada y el olor es insoportable. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Comanche Dr y Calero Ave desde hace 3 años. Mi hijo de seis años tiene alergias y ya fuimos dos veces a la clínica este mes. Hemos pagado el agua caliente por nuestra cuenta porque el calentador tampoco sirve.

Pido que la ciudad mande un inspector para obligar al dueño a reparar el techo y el calentador.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Goteras y moho en el baño

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The building manager shut off the laundry room water for a whole weekend, and now there's a flooded hallway that smells like sewage. The drain line under the sink is backed up, and nobody has come out to clear it. We have had no working toilet on the second floor since Friday.

Please have inspectors check the sewer backup and order the owner to restore plumbing service.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Sewage backup in laundry room

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Our unit has no working heat, and the thermostat just shows an error code.

Please send a city inspector to cite the owner for failing heating.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: No heat, thermostat error

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Tôi là chủ căn nhà cho thuê hai phòng, nhưng hệ thống thoát nước đã bị tắc từ tháng trước. Người thuê báo nước tràn ra sàn bếp và có mùi hôi rất khó chịu. Tôi đã gọi thợ, nhưng thợ nói phải đào vỉa hè để kiểm tra đường ống nên cần giấy phép.

Mong thành phố hướng dẫn thủ tục xin giấy phép và cử người kiểm tra đường ống thoát nước.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Nghẹt cống, nước tràn bếp

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I live near South 15th Street and East San Carlos Street. The bathroom exhaust fan has been broken since spring, and the room stays damp enough to grow mold on the grout.

Please have the owner fix the fan and inspect the moisture problem.

[name removed]
subject: Broken bathroom exhaust fan

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Vivo cerca de Lucerne Way y Higate Drive. Los vidrios de la puerta de la cocina están rotos y no cierran bien, así que entra mucho aire frío y hay cucarachas por los huecos. Ya puse cinta y cartón, pero no aguanta y el dueño dice que no tiene dinero para cambiarlos.

Quisiera que la ciudad revise la puerta y las ventanas y obligue al dueño a repararlas.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Puerta de cocina rota

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Hi,

The hot water tank in our building was replaced twice this year, and it still runs out after about ten minutes. Our downstairs neighbor has no hot water at all right now. I rent an apartment near Airport Blvd and Coleman Ave. Everyone in the building has been asked to shower at different times, which does not work for families with school schedules.

Please order an inspection of the building's water heaters and require a permanent fix.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Repeated hot water tank failures

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
Hi,

We've lived in Meadowlands for 3 years. My rental house has a sewer smell in the kitchen that gets stronger every week.

Please tell me whether an inspection is needed for a suspected sewer line problem.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Sewer smell in rental kitchen

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
To the City Council,

I live at the corner of Minuet Dr and N Capitol Ave. Mold grows on the bedroom closet wall after every rainstorm, and I found it in my daughter's shoes too. The landlord says it's just condensation and won't open the wall to look. We bought a dehumidifier out of our own pocket, but the wall is still damp to the touch.

Please send an inspector to open the wall and check for water intrusion and mold.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Mold behind bedroom closet

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hello,

I rent an apartment near Everglade Ave and Chiplay Dr. The front stairwell light has been out for three weeks, and the handrail is loose.

Please ask the owner to fix the lighting and railing before someone falls.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Dark stairwell and loose railing

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Lahaina Way and Ilikai Ave. Our apartment has had broken window locks since we moved in, so the bedroom window can be opened from outside without a key. When I asked for new locks, the management office said I should buy my own. I work nights and my kids are sometimes home alone, which makes this worse. I have photos and text messages showing each request since August.

Please send an inspector to require working window locks and a secure entry for all units.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Broken window locks

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The ceiling in our bathroom sags more each month, and last winter a chunk of plaster fell into the tub. The owner painted over the stain and says it's cosmetic. There is a light fixture hanging just above the bathtub that worries me.

Please have an inspector check the ceiling for structural problems and cite the owner if needed.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Sagging bathroom ceiling

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
We live just off Harry Road near Bernal Road. The house across from us has been empty for over two years, and the back yard is full of dead weeds and old tires.

Please send code enforcement to inspect the lot and require the owner to clean it up.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Empty house with yard full of weeds

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I live by Almaden Ave and Floyd St with my family. Two cars have been parked on the street in front of our building for almost five months, one with flat tires and no plates. Nobody in the building knows who they belong to. We have called the non-emergency line twice, and both times the car was still there a week later.

Please have the abandoned vehicles tagged and towed so they stop taking up our parking.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Two dead cars parked for months

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Estimados concejales,

La casa vacía de enfrente tiene las ventanas tapiadas con madera y ya le salieron pintas enormes en la barda. Desde hace un año nadie cuida el terreno y se llena de basura. Mis nietos juegan en la calle y me preocupa que alguien entre a esa casa.

Pido que la ciudad obligue al dueño a limpiar el terreno y borrar las pintas.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Casa abandonada con pintas

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The apartment building on the corner has graffiti covering every window of its ground floor, and the paint has been there since the summer. Kids cut through the parking lot to get to the vacant units at night. Some of the tags look like gang signs, and they are getting bigger every week.

Please have graffiti removed from the vacant building and the owner cited if it is not done.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Graffiti on vacant apartment building

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Xin chào,

Căn nhà bỏ hoang cạnh nhà tôi có cỏ dại cao quá đầu người và rác chất đầy trong sân. Gia đình tôi ở gần Basking Ridge Ave và Hellyer Ave.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra và buộc chủ nhà dọn dẹp sân.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Nhà bỏ hoang, cỏ dại và rác

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
To the City Council,

We've lived in West San José for 5 years. The duplex next to our apartment has been vacant since spring, with three windows broken and the back door hanging open. Rats have been moving between its yard and our trash bins every night. Our landlord says it is not his property, so he will not call anyone. I have counted at least six piles of trash the size of a couch in the back yard.

Please send code enforcement to board the windows, clear the yard, and set a deadline for the owner.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Vacant duplex with broken windows and rats

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

We live near the corner of Renaissance Dr and Torrenzia Dr. A camper trailer has been sitting in the driveway next door since January with a flat tire, and it's now covered in leaves. Someone also has an old truck up on jacks in the side yard. Oil stains are running into the storm drain at the curb every time it rains.

Please have the vehicles inspected and removed if they are inoperable or stored illegally.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Inoperable vehicles in driveway

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I live by Purple Hills Drive and Santa Teresa Boulevard with my family. The yard across the street is overgrown with blackberries and piled with broken furniture.

Please send someone to cite the owner for the weeds and junk.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Overgrown yard with junk

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

En la casa de al lado hay un carro sin llantas y sin placas que está estacionado desde hace más de cuatro meses. Además alguien hace reparaciones de motor en la entrada. El aceite se derrama en la calle y los niños pasan por ahí para ir a la escuela.

Pido que la ciudad revise el carro y prohíba las reparaciones en la entrada.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Carro sin placas y reparaciones

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

My auto repair shop shares a lot with an abandoned commercial building that has tagging on every wall. Vandals have been breaking in at night, and I have had to pay for a fence twice. The graffiti is starting to make customers think the block is unsafe.

Please have the vacant building boarded and the graffiti removed within the next thirty days.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Vandalism at vacant building

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Hello,

There's a mattress and two broken chairs dumped on the sidewalk outside the empty lot. I've lived in Norwood since 2015.

Please ask the city to remove the dumped items and cite whoever owns the lot.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Dumped furniture on sidewalk

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

The old house on our block has had a roof tarp flapping in the wind for a year, and water gets into the attic every time it rains. Pieces of siding keep falling onto the sidewalk where kids walk to school. We reported it through the online portal twice, and the case was closed without anyone visiting.

Please have an inspector visit, secure the roof, and order repairs or demolition.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Old house with falling siding

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
May bahay sa tabi namin na walang nakatira simula pa noong nakaraang taon. Puno na ng damo ang bakuran at may mga basurang nakatambak sa likod, at dumadami ang daga. Madalas kaming abalahin ng amoy kapag mainit ang panahon.

Sana ay magpadala ng inspektor ang lungsod para linisin ang bakuran at ipaalam sa may-ari.

[name removed]
subject: Pinabayaang bahay at daga

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The storefront next to my shop has been vacant for three years, with plywood on the windows and tags all over the door. I own a small business near Redmond Ave and Monteverde Dr.

Please require the owner to repair the boards and remove the graffiti.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Vacant storefront with graffiti

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Someone has been parking an RV on the lot next to my house for most of the year, and it has not moved since spring. It has no visible registration and the tires are flat. There is a hose running from it to the neighbor's outdoor faucet, which looks like a long-term hookup.

Please check whether the RV is stored illegally and have it removed if it is abandoned.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Abandoned RV on vacant lot

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Hay un terreno lleno de llantas viejas, cajas y escombros que huele muy mal. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Williford Drive y North Capitol Avenue desde hace 12 años.

Pido que la ciudad mande alguien a limpiar el terreno y multar al dueño.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Terreno con llantas y escombros

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

We live near the corner of Candia Dr and McLaughlin Ave. The house across the alley has a broken garage door that has been wide open for a month, and there are shopping carts and pallets stacked against the fence. Anyone can wander in and out of the back yard, and the open garage looks like an invitation to whoever walks by. I called the non-emergency number twice, but they told me it is a code matter and gave me a case number. Nothing has changed since.

Please send code enforcement to secure the garage and remove the stacked materials.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Open garage at vacant house

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I own a small moving company, and our trucks get blocked by a row of junked cars on the street next to our yard. Two of them have been there since last winter with no plates. I own a small business near Lochner Drive and Griffith Street. We have to park our trucks in a separate lot now, which costs us money every month.

Please have the inoperable cars towed so our loading area is clear.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Junked cars block our loading

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi sống ở khu Chaboya đã 27 năm. Ngôi nhà bỏ trống bên kia đường đã nhiều năm, cửa sổ bị đập vỡ và có người vẽ bậy khắp tường. Ban đêm thường có người lạ ra vào và đống rác trước sân ngày càng cao. Hai đứa con tôi đi học ngang đó mỗi ngày nên tôi rất lo. Tôi đã báo qua mạng hai lần nhưng chưa thấy ai đến kiểm tra.

Mong thành phố kiểm tra, bịt cửa sổ và buộc chủ nhà dọn sạch khu vực này.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Nhà bỏ trống, cửa vỡ

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The apartment complex's old carport has collapsed onto a car, and the rest of the structure is leaning toward the sidewalk. I've lived in Sakamota since 2018.

Please have an inspector assess the carport and require it to be removed.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Collapsed carport next door

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Estimados concejales,

Vivo cerca de Leigh Ave y Kingman Ave. En la esquina hay una casa abandonada con la puerta abierta y basura en el porche.

Quisiera que la ciudad la revise y obligue a cerrarla.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Casa abandonada con puerta abierta

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

Our hardware store has had graffiti on the back alley wall for six months, and the nearby vacant building has broken windows that keep getting broken. Customers complain about the mess, and the trash cans get knocked over every night. I have paid to repaint the wall twice, and it gets tagged again within days.

Please have code enforcement require the vacant property owner to clean up the graffiti and secure the windows.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Repeated graffiti at our store

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Dear Councilmember,

The lot behind us has had a rusted pickup on blocks for over a year, with its hood open and oil dripping into the gravel. There is also a pile of drywall, a dead tree, and old tires that have been sitting out in the rain. When it rains, the oil runs toward the storm drain, and I am worried about the creek. We have asked the owner, and he just says he will get to it when he can.

Please order the owner to remove the vehicle, the tires, and the debris, and check for illegal dumping.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Rusted truck leaking oil

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I rent an apartment near Foxworthy Ave and Julio Ave. The empty lot next to our complex is covered in tall dry weeds, and there's a broken shopping cart in the middle of it.

Please send someone to mow the lot and clear the weeds before fire season.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Tall dry weeds on empty lot

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hi,

I've lived in Ocala since 2015. Our backyard ADU application has been sitting in plan check since June with no comments from the city. We have paid the fees and answered every question the reviewer sent.

Please assign a plan checker to finish the review or tell us exactly what is still missing.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: ADU permit stuck in plan check

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Foxworthy Ave y Cherry Ave desde hace 12 años. Mi casero quiere arreglar el baño y la cocina de nuestro edificio, pero el permiso lleva casi cinco meses en revisión sin respuesta. Mientras tanto seguimos con el agua fría y la estufa rota porque no pueden empezar.

Pido que la ciudad agilice la revisión del permiso para que puedan empezar las reparaciones.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Permiso de remodelación atorado

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hi,

As a licensed contractor, I have a solar installation waiting on a city permit that was filed nearly three months ago. Clients are canceling because the schedule keeps slipping. My crew sat idle for two weeks in August, and that cost me about four thousand dollars.

Please give small contractors a clear timeline for solar permit review and tell us where the file is.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Solar permit delay hurts crews

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My landlord applied for a kitchen remodel permit in April, and it is still not approved as of today. We live near the corner of Chynoweth Avenue and Colony Crest Drive. Our upstairs neighbors are waiting on the same permit, so everyone's repairs are stuck.

Please speed up the review so the repairs can start before the lease ends.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Kitchen remodel permit pending

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi nộp hồ sơ xin phép sửa nhà từ tháng Năm nhưng đến nay vẫn chưa có kết quả. Mỗi lần gọi họ chỉ nói hồ sơ đang chờ xử lý. Tôi phải thuê nhà tạm vì căn bếp đã tháo dỡ mà chưa được xây lại.

Mong thành phố cho biết hồ sơ đang ở bước nào và đẩy nhanh việc duyệt.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Hồ sơ xin phép sửa nhà

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
To the City Council,

We applied for a rooftop solar permit in February, and the online portal still says 'under review.' The installer has our panels sitting in the garage. Every month we wait is another bill with no savings, and we have already paid the full fee. The installer keeps asking whether we have heard anything.

Please post a realistic processing timeline for residential solar permits and move ours forward.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Rooftop solar permit stalled

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Council Office,

Our bathroom remodel permit has been on hold for six weeks because a single inspection report hasn't been logged.

Please check why the inspection report is missing and clear the hold.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Bathroom remodel on hold

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Llevo tres meses esperando el permiso para construir un cuarto chico en el patio y nadie me dice en qué etapa va.

Pido que la ciudad me diga en qué etapa está mi permiso y cuánto falta.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Permiso para cuarto en el patio

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hello,

We rent a converted garage that the owner is trying to legalize, and the permit has been pending for almost a year. Until it is approved, the owner cannot raise the rent or fix the back wall. Our kids share one room, and the wall dampness gets worse every rainy month.

Please prioritize the permit review so the unit can be legalized and repaired.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Legalizing converted garage unit

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My bakery's tenant improvement permit has been stuck in review since spring, and our opening date keeps moving. I own a small business near Rainbow Drive and Petal Way.

Please assign a staff member to tell us what is blocking the permit.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Bakery permit stuck since spring

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The permit fees for a basic water heater swap are now more than three hundred dollars, yet the inspection still takes weeks to schedule. Paying more for slower service does not seem fair to homeowners.

Please reconsider the fee increase unless the city commits to faster permit reviews.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Permit fees up, service still slow

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
To the City Council,

We've lived in Alum Rock for 7 years. Tenants pay the price when repair permits sit in review for months.

Please fund more plan checkers so repair permits move faster.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Plan checkers needed for repairs

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Vivo cerca de Blossom Acres Drive y Blossom Valley Drive. Los derechos de permiso para mi negocio subieron mucho el año pasado, pero la revisión tarda semanas. Pagamos más y seguimos esperando. Si tuviéramos más personal que revisara planos, no nos afectaría tanto la espera.

Pido que la ciudad baje las cuotas o contrate más revisores para dar un servicio más rápido.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Costos de permiso y espera larga

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
To the City Council,

I would support a fee increase if the money went toward hiring more plan checkers, because my ADU file has been waiting since spring. Right now the fees are being paid and the backlog keeps growing. We were quoted four months for a simple review, and the quote has already slipped twice.

Please tie any fee increase to a published plan-check staffing plan with target turnaround times.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Support fees tied to staffing

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hello,

We live just off Quesada Drive near Henessy Drive. The landlord in our building is waiting on a plan check for a sewer repair, and the city has no published timeline for it. Every week the sewer line stays broken is another week our bathroom does not work. The staff at the counter said the reviewer has a backlog of about two hundred files, and that is the reason. We are asking for more reviewers so these basic repairs stop dragging on.

Please add plan checkers and publish turnaround times for repair permits like sewer work.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Sewer repair stuck in review

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I live at the corner of Leyland Park Drive and Rimrock Drive. The environmental review for the proposed warehouse near us only studied traffic and says nothing about the diesel trucks idling at night.

Please require a full air quality study before the council votes on the warehouse.

[name removed]
subject: Warehouse review skips air quality

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

The developers of the housing complex next to us used an old water study from before the drought, and nobody has checked whether the aquifer can handle the new units. I live by Loop Road and Bernal Road with my family. The older homes on our street already report low pressure in the summer.

Please order an updated water supply analysis that reflects current drought conditions.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Outdated water study for new homes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

The gas station rebuild proposed across from my house would add two extra fuel canopies and a convenience store, but the traffic study counted cars only on a Tuesday morning. The soil testing only covers the front half of the lot, not where the old underground tanks were. Anyone who drives this stretch knows the Tuesday counts miss the school rush and the weekend tourist traffic. I want the city to require borings under the old tank area before any approval.

Please require a full environmental review with soil borings and weekend traffic counts before approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Gas station soil and traffic gaps

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Hanchett Ave y Sequoia Ave desde hace 20 años. El estudio ambiental del nuevo almacén cerca de nosotros no mide el polvo ni el ruido de los camiones de noche.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio completo de calidad del aire antes de aprobarlo.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Estudio de aire del almacén

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Hello,

I own a restaurant two blocks from the proposed data center, and the environmental review does not address the backup generators at all. Testing them could mean monthly diesel noise and exhaust. I run a shop near the corner of Bluefield Dr and Vistapark Dr. Customers already complain about freeway noise, and I cannot afford another source.

Please require the review to analyze generator emissions and testing schedules before the project moves forward.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Restaurant worried about generators

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Báo cáo đánh giá môi trường cho dự án nhà ở gần nhà tôi chỉ đo lưu lượng xe vào buổi sáng, chưa xét đến tiếng ồn và bụi xây dựng. Gia đình tôi có người già và trẻ nhỏ, nên bụi và tiếng ồn ảnh hưởng nhiều.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đo bụi và tiếng ồn trước khi phê duyệt.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Đánh giá bỏ sót bụi và ồn

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The environmental report says the rezoned parcel has no wetlands, but I have seen standing water there every spring. My house is right at Brigadoon Way and Laddie Way.

Please have the city recheck the wetlands delineation before approving the rezoning.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Wetlands claim doesn't match

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I live by Rainbow Drive and Arlington Lane with my family. The study for the new apartment block near our building looked at hazardous soil but not construction dust, which would blow directly into our windows. Our kids have asthma. Construction could go on for two years, and we have no idea who will check the dust controls.

Please require a dust and construction noise plan with enforceable limits for the apartment project.

[name removed]
subject: Dust from apartment construction

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The review for the rezoned parcel near our shop left out truck routes, and our delivery vans would have to use the same narrow road.

Please ask the applicant to add a truck route analysis before the hearing.

[name removed]
subject: Truck routes missing from review

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

La estación de gasolina que quieren construir enfrente de mi casa necesita revisar el suelo, pero el estudio solo llega hasta el frente del terreno. Hay tanques viejos que nadie ha revisado. Mi esposa tiene problemas de los pulmones y no quiero que el vapor de gasolina nos afecte.

Pido que la ciudad exija análisis del subsuelo en todo el terreno antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Estación de gasolina sin estudio de suelo

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Our family has been in La Pala for 16 years. The developer's air study for the new apartment complex used data from a monitor six miles away, not from the lot itself. The truck route in the report goes right past the playground where my daughter's school lets out. We already breathe dust from the freeway, and I am not sure this report accounts for that. A new monitor placed on the site would give us real numbers.

Please require an air monitor on the site and a corrected truck route analysis before approval.

[name removed]
subject: Air monitor too far from site

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi thuê nhà gần khu đất sắp xây kho hàng, nhưng báo cáo môi trường không hề nói đến xe tải chạy đêm.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu bổ sung đánh giá về xe tải chạy đêm trước khi duyệt.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Kho hàng và xe tải ban đêm

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Hi,

The data center review lists a cooling water figure but does not say where the water comes from during a dry year. I would like to understand the plan before I form an opinion. I live by Bloomsbury Way and Piedmont Rd with my family. I have no problem with new jobs, but I want the numbers to hold up.

Please publish the water source and dry-year supply plan for the data center.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Dry-year water supply unclear

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

El desarrollo de vivienda nuevo cerca de nosotros no incluye un estudio de agua, y solo dicen que el agua de los pozos vecinos no se afectará. Nadie nos ha mostrado cómo lo comprobaron. Vivo cerca de South Capitol Avenue y Ocala Avenue. Varios vecinos ya tienen agua con poca presión en el verano.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio de agua actualizado antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Agua para el desarrollo nuevo

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

The appendix on noise in the warehouse report has no measurements from our side of the street.

Please require noise measurements at the nearest homes before the hearing.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: No noise data for nearby homes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

The new subdivision upstream would pave over the last open field, and I am worried the storm drains on our street cannot handle the runoff. Our basement flooded twice in the last five years, and both times the water came up through the storm drain.

Please require a drainage study that models a 100-year storm with the new paved surfaces.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Upstream subdivision will worsen drains

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I live at the corner of W Walbrook Dr and Heckman Way. Every time the creek rises, our street gets water up to the curb, and the proposed warehouse would cover more ground.

Please require the developer to show how the site will drain without adding water to our street.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Creek flooding on our street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Si construyen el proyecto nuevo de vivienda, el agua de lluvia va a bajar directo a las casas de abajo. Ya hay charcos cada vez que llueve fuerte. Mi sótano se inundó en 2019 y nadie del gobierno nos explicó por qué.

Pido que la ciudad revise el plan de drenaje y exija bombas o tanques de retención.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Proyecto nuevo y charcos

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Hello,

I'm a Communications Hill homeowner. As the owner of a small car wash near the proposed data center site, I am worried the project could change how water drains down our block. Our wash already loses a day's business after heavy rain. We would lose money every time the lot floods, and the neighbors would be stuck too.

Please require the project to include stormwater retention and show how the lot will drain.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Car wash worried about runoff

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Khu đất mới được đổi sang xây nhà ở cách nhà tôi không xa, mà phần đất này trước đây là ruộng thấp nên nước dễ đọng. Nếu lát bê tông hết, nước sẽ tràn về phía nhà chúng tôi. Tôi sống ở khu La Pala. Mùa mưa năm ngoái nước đã ngập đến hiên nhà, và chúng tôi phải dọn đồ lên gác. Tôi lo dự án này sẽ làm tình trạng ngập tệ hơn.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu nhà đầu tư xây hồ chứa nước mưa và chứng minh không gây ngập.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Đất trũng và nước ngập

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
To the City Council,

The rezoned parcel behind our apartment has a culvert that clogs every year, and nobody says what happens to it once the lot is built. Our unit is on the ground floor. Last spring the parking lot filled with water and two cars were stuck in it.

Please require an inspection of the culvert and a plan to keep runoff off our property.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Culvert clogs behind apartments

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Paving the lot upstream would send more runoff straight into the drain that already backs up.

Please require stormwater retention before the project gets a permit.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Upstream paving adds runoff

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Nos preocupa que el agua del pozo baje si construyen todas esas casas nuevas en la zona.

Pido que la ciudad exija un estudio del agua subterránea antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Agua del pozo en riesgo

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
To the City Council,

We live just off Ford Rd near Summer Dr. The proposed data center plans to pull groundwater for cooling, and the report only says the impact will be 'minimal.' Nobody has told us what minimal means for the wells that homes on our street still use. Our neighbor's well went dry in 2022 during the drought, and the county never investigated. Once a project draws from the same layer, the impact is hard to undo.

Please require the developer to quantify groundwater draw and commit to recycled water for cooling.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Data center groundwater draw

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I rent a unit close to the proposed housing site, and the water pressure already drops every summer when the neighbors water their lawns. Adding a hundred new units could make it worse for all of us. I called the water department twice about low pressure, and they told me to run the tap in the morning.

Please require the city to confirm water supply capacity before the housing project is approved.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Summer water pressure dropping

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The proposed warehouse would add about four hundred truck trips a day on our two-lane road, and the traffic report counted only passenger cars.

Please require the traffic study to count truck trips and include our street in the analysis.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Truck trips missing from traffic count

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Our street already has no parking after six o'clock because of the apartments, and the new building would bring another hundred residents with cars. People park across our driveways and block the mailboxes, and there is no plan to deal with it.

Please require the developer to provide on-site parking or a parking permit plan before approval.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: No parking on our street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Xin chào,

Tòa nhà mới cao tám tầng sẽ che hết ánh nắng cho sân sau nhà tôi, và đường trước nhà đã kẹt xe mỗi giờ tan tầm. Tôi sống ở khu Village Oaks. Vợ tôi trồng rau trong sân và đã mất gần hết mùa vì bóng râm.

Mong thành phố giảm chiều cao tòa nhà hoặc yêu cầu lùi đường xây về sau để bớt bóng râm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Tòa nhà cao gây bóng râm

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I've been a homeowner near N 33rd St and McKee Rd for 20 years. We have seven vacant storefronts on the main street already, and the new mixed-use project would add four more empty spaces that might never lease. It feels like the block is losing its character one closed shop at a time. The old hardware store and two restaurants have closed in the last three years. I would like the city to require tenant-ready retail before any new space is approved.

Please require a retail leasing plan with local tenants before approving any new ground-floor space.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Storefront vacancies on main street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Irwindale Dr y Aborn Rd desde hace 9 años. Con el edificio nuevo habrá muchísimos más carros en la calle y la escuela ya tiene problemas con el tráfico a la salida.

Pido que la ciudad revise el tráfico en horas de escuela antes de aprobar el proyecto.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Tráfico escolar sin estudiar

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Dear Council Office,

I've lived in Hellyer since 2010. The developer wants a five-story building right next to a single-family street, and the zoning would let them block our afternoon sun. We are not against housing, just against a building that size in the middle of a quiet block. Our homes are one and two stories, and the new building would tower over the back fences.

Please keep the height limit at three stories along our side of the street.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Five-story building next to homes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I just don't like how fast the area is changing. There used to be a family-owned bakery and a shoe repair place here.

Please consider neighborhood character when the council reviews the project.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Neighborhood changing too fast

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
我在这条街上经营一家小餐馆，新的住宅楼如果建成，门口的停车位会更加紧张，外卖和送货车也会堵在路上。 每到周末晚上，街口已经排了很长的车，顾客经常找不到车位。

希望城市在审批前评估停车和送货车的影响，并要求开发商提供停车方案。

[name removed]
subject: 小餐馆与停车压力

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

The building is too tall for the street, and it feels out of place next to our one-story homes.

Please ask the design review board to reconsider the height.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Building too tall for street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

Cars already speed down our side street to avoid the light, and the proposed apartments would send another few hundred trips onto it. Kids on bikes have almost been hit twice this year. I reported it to traffic engineering, and they said the speed bumps are on a waiting list.

Please require traffic calming on our street as part of the project approval.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Speeding cars on side street

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Hola,

Quieren cambiar el terreno a uso comercial y eso significa camiones de entrega todo el día frente a nuestras casas. Ya hay ruido y basura desde que cerró la tienda vieja. Mi mamá vive sola y ya no puede cruzar la calle por el tráfico de los fines de semana.

Pido que la ciudad limite los horarios de entrega y revise el impacto en la calle antes de aprobar el cambio.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Entregas en el terreno comercial

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
The left-turn pocket at the corner has no signal timing for the morning rush, so drivers cut across our driveway.

Please have traffic engineering re-time the signal before any new trips are added.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Unsafe left-turn lane at corner

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Lối đi trước khu nhà chúng tôi đã không còn chỗ đậu xe sau 6 giờ tối, nay thêm tòa nhà mới thì càng chật.

Mong thành phố yêu cầu chủ dự án có kế hoạch chỗ đậu xe ngay trong khu đất.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Thiếu chỗ đậu xe

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I live in Flickinger. The new mixed-use plan would send delivery trucks down the alley behind our apartments starting at five every morning. The alley is only one lane, and two residents have already had cars scraped when trucks squeeze through. We have complained to the property office and were told the truck route is 'not finalized.' I think the city should set the route before approving anything that depends on it.

Please require a fixed truck route and delivery hours in the approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Truck deliveries down narrow alley

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

The planned apartments are near the freeway on-ramp, and the study ignores how backed up the ramp gets at rush hour. Adding a few hundred cars there will likely mean longer waits for everyone trying to get home. I live by Union Avenue and Heimgartner Lane with my family. I drive that ramp every day, and it is already a fifteen-minute wait. I would like the traffic study to model the actual peak-hour backup, not just average counts.

Please require a peak-hour traffic analysis at the on-ramp before the project is approved.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: On-ramp backups at rush hour

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hi,

We live just off Santa Teresa Blvd near Miyuki Dr. I support the new townhome project on the empty parcel, as long as the builder keeps the sidewalk open during construction.

Please make sidewalk closures a permit condition, with daily noise and dust limits.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Support townhomes with sidewalk access

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Overall I think a mixed-use building would be good for the corner, and I would rather see it than another vacant lot. I am not going to pretend I have all the technical answers, but I trust the planning staff to set fair conditions.

Please approve it only after the conditions on parking and shade are written into the permit.

[name removed]
subject: General support for mixed-use

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Suportado ko ang bagong proyekto ng pabahay sa lote malapit sa amin, basta may malinaw na tuntunin para sa ingay at trapiko. Gusto ko lang masiguro na hindi aabalahin ang mga batang pumapasok sa paaralan tuwing umaga.

Sana ay isama ng lungsod ang oras ng konstruksyon at limitasyon sa ingay sa permit.

[name removed]
subject: Suporta sa pabahay na proyekto

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My family and I live in Palmia Park. We would support the warehouse expansion if the developer agrees to hire locally for at least a third of the construction jobs. Our neighborhood has a lot of skilled trades workers who are out of work right now.

Please write the local hiring commitment into the approval with quarterly reporting.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Warehouse expansion with local hiring

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Vivo cerca de Leeward Dr y Lucerne Way. Apoyo el proyecto de vivienda si reservan una parte para familias de ingreso bajo.

Pido que la ciudad ponga esa condición por escrito en el permiso.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Apoyo con vivienda accesible

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I support the new park-and-housing plan as long as the developer uses recycled water for landscaping.

Please require recycled water for landscaping and irrigation as a condition of approval.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Support housing with recycled water

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi ủng hộ dự án chung cư mới nếu chủ đầu tư giới hạn giờ thi công đến 6 giờ chiều và giữ đường đi bộ an toàn. Trẻ con trong khu phố đi học qua đây mỗi ngày nên tôi rất quan tâm.

Mong thành phố đưa điều kiện giờ thi công và đường đi bộ vào giấy phép.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Ủng hộ chung cư có điều kiện

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I'm for the new bike lanes and two-story condos on the lot if the builder pays for the new crosswalk. I live at the corner of Redmond Avenue and McAbee Road.

Please require the developer to fund the crosswalk before occupancy.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Bike lanes and crosswalk funding

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I want the new housing to happen, but only with a noise schedule that keeps construction out of early mornings.

Please write a construction hours limit into the permit for the lot near us.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Construction hours for new housing

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hello,

The proposed mixed-use building could bring needed shops, but only if it is sized to fit the block and the developer commits to ground-floor retail that stays open. Right now the plan calls for empty storefronts, which is exactly what we already have too many of. I would support it with a cap on height and a commitment to local tenants for the storefronts. Otherwise I would rather the lot wait for a better plan.

Please approve it only with a height limit and a local-tenant leasing commitment for ground-floor retail.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Mixed-use with height cap

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Council Office,

We live just off Foxborough Dr near Tradewinds Dr. Another rent increase notice arrived this month and it is more than my raise at work.

Please keep the annual rent cap strong and close any loopholes that let landlords avoid it.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Rent cap should stay strong

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

I own a duplex and I am worried that a lower annual cap will leave me unable to cover repairs. My property taxes and insurance have gone up every year, and the cap has not kept pace with those costs.

Please let the council consider a cap formula that covers my real operating costs.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Concerns about the proposed rent cap

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hola,

Mi renta subió otra vez este año y ya no alcanza para la comida y la luz. Mi casero ni siquiera explicó por qué subió tanto, y cada año es lo mismo.

Les pido que mantengan el tope anual de renta y que no permitan excepciones para los dueños.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Tope de renta anual

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Every spring the notice comes and the new number is always higher than what I can comfortably pay. I have lived in my unit for six years and I have never once been late on rent. The last increase made me cut back on medicine for my mother.

Please keep the yearly cap in place and make sure it covers every type of rental.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Rent increase again

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Our family has been in Plata Arroyo for 16 years. I think the rent rules have gotten too heavy for people who own only one or two units.

Please think about small owners before you make the rules any stricter.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Rules feel heavy for small owners

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Carryback Avenue và Indian Broom Drive. Tiền thuê nhà của gia đình tôi vừa tăng thêm gần bốn trăm đô mỗi tháng.

Tôi mong hội đồng giữ giới hạn tăng tiền thuê hằng năm và siết chặt việc thi hành.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Xin giữ mức tăng tiền thuê

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
I run a shop near the corner of Morse Street and West Hedding Street. My company manages about forty small buildings and a stricter cap would push some owners to sell. Some of my clients have already told me they cannot keep up with maintenance costs under the current limit.

Please add a hardship process so owners facing real losses can request a higher increase.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Small property manager concerns

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Wonderama Drive and Ocala Avenue. I got a notice saying my increase is within the limit, but I cannot figure out how the number was calculated. The notice listed a percentage but did not show the base amount or the date it applies.

Please require landlords to show the calculation on every rent increase notice.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: How is the cap calculated?

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Buenas tardes,

Tengo una casa con dos cuartos para rentar y el tope actual no me deja cubrir la reparación del techo. Vivo cerca de Redmond Ave y Mancuso St.

Les pido que revisen la fórmula del tope para que tome en cuenta los gastos reales del dueño.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Preocupación por el tope de renta

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

My rent jumped in August and nothing about my building or my pay justified it.

Please enforce the yearly cap so families can plan their budgets.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Yearly increase too high

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
I rent out a condo I bought ten years ago and I am still confused about which rent limits apply to it. I'm a Welch Park homeowner. The city website explains the cap in general terms, but I could not find a clear answer for units built after a certain year. I have called the office several times and waited on hold for a long time.

Please publish a simple chart showing which rental units are covered by the cap and which are exempt.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Which rent limits apply to my unit?

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hello,

Our building manager raised rent by the maximum allowed and then added a new monthly trash fee on top. That fee was not in our lease, and the increase came right after we asked for a repair that never got done.

Please make sure fees count toward the rent cap so landlords cannot shift costs around it.

[name removed]
subject: Fees hidden inside the rent

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Tôi cho thuê một căn nhà nhỏ và chi phí bảo trì, bảo hiểm tăng liên tục nên giới hạn hiện nay làm tôi khó xoay sở. Gia đình tôi ở gần McKean Road và Cahen Drive. Tôi đã phải hoãn sửa mái nhà hai năm vì không đủ tiền thu từ tiền thuê.

Tôi đề nghị hội đồng xem xét cho phép tăng thêm khi chủ nhà có chi phí thực tế được chứng minh.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Ý kiến về giới hạn tăng tiền thuê

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our small rental business cannot absorb a cap that stays flat while insurance keeps climbing. We've lived in Vinci Park for 9 years.

Please build in an adjustment for insurance and repair costs when setting the cap.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Insurance costs and the cap

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

Another increase notice showed up in my mailbox and I am tired of guessing what the next one will be. I live at the corner of Lanning Way and N Jackson Ave. I have rented in the same place for nine years, and the total increase now is almost a third of my monthly pay.

I hope the council keeps caring about renters when it reviews these rules.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Rent went up again

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Dear Council Office,

After I reported a broken heater to the landlord, I got a notice ending my tenancy with no reason given. Our family has been in Strawberry Park for 27 years. My kids have been sleeping in coats because the unit stays so cold, and I have a copy of every text I sent. I went to a legal aid clinic and they said I might have some protection, but the process is confusing and expensive.

Please fund free legal help for tenants who get eviction notices after requesting repairs.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Eviction after I asked for repairs

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

Recibimos un aviso de desalojo con un mes de plazo y no nos dieron ninguna razón por escrito. Mi esposo trabaja de noche y estamos buscando dónde vivir con tres niños, lo cual es muy difícil con este tipo de aviso.

Les pido que hagan más fuertes las protecciones para familias que reciben avisos de desalojo sin causa.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Desalojo sin razón clara

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I am a homeowner renting out a room and the eviction process for nonpaying tenants takes months to finish. I live near Millbrook Drive and Yancy Drive.

Please speed up the process for property owners who have documented unpaid rent.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Slow process for nonpaying tenants

item_title: Proactive rental inspection and habitability enforcement
text:
To the City Council,

I rent an apartment near Trowbridge Way and Country Club Pkwy. I am scared to complain about mold because the last person who did got a rent hike two weeks later.

Please add stronger penalties for landlords who retaliate against tenants who report code problems.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Afraid to report problems

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi nhận thông báo chấm dứt thuê nhà sau khi tôi phản ánh chuyện hệ thống nước bị rò rỉ. Chúng tôi đã ở đây bảy năm, con gái tôi đang học lớp chín và rất khó tìm nhà mới trong thời gian ngắn.

Tôi mong thành phố có thêm quy định bảo vệ người thuê khi báo cáo việc sửa chữa.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Lo sợ bị đuổi khỏi nhà

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
We run a small apartment building and I am not sure how many days notice we must give before filing for an eviction. Different staff members have given us different answers, and we want to follow the rules correctly.

Please publish a one-page guide that lists the notice rules for small building operators.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Notice rules for small building operators

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hello,

Three families in my building got eviction notices in the same month, and nobody told us why. Most of us have lived here for over a decade and we are all struggling to find something we can afford nearby.

Please require a written reason and a relocation plan before a landlord can end a long tenancy.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Three families got notices

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a retired homeowner with one rental unit and I need to know the rules before I ever evict anyone.

Please post clear just-cause rules so owners like me can follow them correctly.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Just-cause rules for owners

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Me llegó un aviso de desalojo después de quejarme por la plaga de cucarachas en mi cocina.

Les pido que castiguen a los caseros que quieren desalojar a quien reporta problemas de salud.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Aviso de desalojo por quejarme

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I was given thirty days to leave after I asked the office to fix the back door lock. The notice did not give a reason, and I believe it was because of the complaint I filed with the city. My daughter has asthma and I cannot move her across town during the school year.

Please pass protections that bar eviction notices filed within six months of a city complaint.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Eviction after a complaint

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I am a renter who really wants the council to care about people who get pushed out. We live near the corner of Hanchett Ave and Sequoia Ave. Many of my friends have moved away from the area because of this problem, and I think that is sad.

I hope the council keeps working on tenant protections in the coming months.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Thanks for hearing renters

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
我们一家住在出租屋里，房东突然发出搬离通知，没有说明理由。

希望市议会加强租户保护，禁止在没有正当理由的情况下驱逐租户。

[name removed]
subject: 关于租户保护的请求

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I live by Ridgemont Drive and Ocala Avenue with my family. I manage my late father's old duplex and I want to follow the eviction rules without making a mistake. I have been told that the notice period differs depending on the reason, and I would like a clear list of each reason.

Please provide a checklist for owners who need to file for eviction.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Checklist for owners filing eviction

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Hi,

My lease ended and the landlord says I must leave in two weeks even though I paid every month.

Please fund a free city hotline that tenants can call when they get a surprise move-out notice.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Need help with a move-out notice

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Nakatanggap kami ng abiso na kailangan naming umalis sa loob ng tatlumpung araw nang walang dahilan. Matagal na kaming nakatira dito at ang mga anak ko ay nasa malapit na paaralan, kaya napakahirap ang ganitong biglaang abiso.

Hinihiling namin sa konseho na palakasin ang proteksyon laban sa paalis na walang dahilan.

[name removed]
subject: Paalis sa tinitirhan

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
To the City Council,

We've lived in Playa del Rey for 20 years. I bought my house because the lot is quiet and I do not want a fourplex built on the lot next door. Our street has narrow parking and the driveways are already full on weekends.

Please keep the current limits for single-family lots and require public notice before any change.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Opposed to fourplexes next door

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Hi,

I want to build a small backyard unit so my parents can live close to us without moving far.

Please keep the process for backyard units fast and make permit fees affordable.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Support backyard units

item_title: Permitting modernization and fee schedule
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Annona Ave y Harbor View Ave desde hace 5 años. Mi hijo ya tiene familia y no puede encontrar un lugar para rentar cerca de nosotros, así que apoyo que se construyan más casas. Si se permite un cuarto extra o una unidad pequeña en el patio, muchas familias podrían quedarse en la ciudad.

Les pido que faciliten los permisos para unidades pequeñas en los patios de las casas unifamiliares.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Apoyo para más viviendas

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Dear Council Office,

I share a two-bedroom with my sister and her two kids because nothing else in our price range is available. I rent an apartment near Coakley Drive and Holly Hock Court. If the city allowed more small buildings in areas that already have buses and sidewalks, we would have more options. We are tired of waiting on lists that never seem to move.

Please let fourplexes and small apartments be built on more lots so that families can find homes.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Sharing a two-bedroom

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
I think single-family zoning is part of why our area still feels like a real community.

I hope the council will think carefully before changing those rules again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Keep single-family zoning

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi Hội đồng,

Gia đình tôi ở gần Foxridge Way và Viceroy Way. Tôi muốn xây thêm một căn nhà nhỏ phía sau nhà để con cháu có chỗ ở gần mình. Thủ tục cấp phép hiện nay quá lâu và nhiều chi phí, làm nhiều gia đình nản chí.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố đơn giản hóa thủ tục và giảm lệ phí cho nhà ở nhỏ phía sau.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Ủng hộ nhà ở nhỏ trên lô đất

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I have a rental unit with an old garage I would like to convert, but the rules make that almost impossible. The rules require a full setback review even for a small change, which adds months and thousands of dollars.

Please let owners convert existing garages into homes without a lengthy extra review.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Garage conversions

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
To the City Council,

I've lived in Willow Vale since 1999. A plan to put several units on each lot would change how our block looks and feels within a few years. Our street has one lane of parking and the sewer line already backs up after big storms. Adding that many families without new infrastructure would make both problems worse.

Please require an infrastructure study before any upzoning proposal for residential lots gets a vote.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Concerns about the density plan

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Hi,

Rents keep climbing because there are too few homes for the number of people who want to live here.

Please approve more small multi-unit homes in every part of the city.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: More homes please

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I am thinking about adding a fourplex on my lot and I want to understand the rules before I spend money. Some neighbors told me the process has changed twice in the last few years.

Could the city summarize recent fourplex rule changes in one place?

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Question about fourplex rules

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Buenas tardes,

Mi familia vive en un cuarto y los precios siguen subiendo porque hay muy pocas casas disponibles. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Di Salvo Ave y Bailey Ave desde hace 16 años.

Les pido que permitan más casas pequeñas y edificios de cuatro unidades en toda la ciudad.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Más vivienda accesible

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Hi,

Every new building on our block adds more cars, and there is nowhere left to park after dinner. We live near the corner of Sierraville Avenue and Crater Lane.

Please require off-street parking for every new home built in single-family areas.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Parking and traffic worries

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Hi,

I run a small contracting business and I have turned down jobs because the current rules make small projects too expensive. Smaller projects would keep my crew busy and bring more homes onto the market faster.

Please simplify the rules for adding one or two units on existing residential lots.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Contractor supports smaller homes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Gia đình tôi có ba người phải ở chung một phòng vì giá thuê nhà quá cao.

Tôi mong thành phố cho phép xây thêm nhà ở nhỏ ở nhiều khu dân cư hơn.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Cần thêm nhà ở

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Hi,

The older houses on our block have character and I worry that new big buildings would erase it. We live near the corner of Lincoln Ave and Norval Way. Some of the homes here were built over a hundred years ago, and that history matters to the people who live here now.

Please protect older single-family blocks from upzoning without a community meeting first.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Keep older blocks as they are

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a homeowner who believes we should fund affordable housing even if it costs me a little more in taxes.

Please approve the affordable housing bond and make sure the money goes to projects quickly.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Vote yes on the housing bond

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
My daughter and I are on a waiting list for a subsidized unit that has been closed for two years. If the city reopens funding for new affordable units, families like ours would finally have a real chance.

Please prioritize bond funding for new affordable apartments that serve extremely low-income households.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Bond money for families

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Trabajo en una fábrica y mi sueldo no alcanza para pagar un departamento, aunque trabajo todos los días. Muchos compañeros duermen en carros o se mudan lejos porque no encuentran algo accesible. Un fondo de vivienda asequible podría cambiar eso para la gente que trabaja todos los días.

Les pido que aprueben el fondo de vivienda asequible y que den prioridad a los trabajadores de bajos ingresos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Vivienda asequible para trabajadores

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hello,

I live at the corner of Foxworthy Ave and Plummer Ave. I am opposed to another bond measure because our property taxes are already high and we are on a fixed income. I have seen past bonds take years to produce housing, and I want the city to show results before asking for more.

Please delay any new housing bond until the city publishes results from the last one.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Oppose the new housing bond

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,
