I keep hearing about affordable housing money, but I cannot tell where the funding comes from.

Please publish a plain-language summary of where the affordable housing funding comes from.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Where does the housing money come from?

item_title: Apartment Rent Ordinance amendment: annual rent-increase cap
text:
Xin chào,

Tôi sống gần Terra Bella Ave và Lincoln Ave. Tôi là chủ nhà ở đây nhiều năm và ủng hộ việc dùng quỹ để xây nhà giá rẻ cho người lao động. Con cái của nhiều hàng xóm phải chuyển đi xa vì không đủ tiền thuê nhà gần trường.

Tôi mong hội đồng thông qua quỹ này và công khai tiến độ xây dựng.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Ủng hộ quỹ nhà ở giá rẻ

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

Our company builds affordable apartments and we can only start projects when local funding is committed on time. Delays in approving gap financing have pushed two of our projects back by almost a year.

Please approve gap financing on schedule so affordable projects do not stall.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Developer perspective on funding

item_title: Illegal dumping response and Coyote Creek cleanup
text:
Hi,

I work two jobs and still cannot afford a place that is not overcrowded. My family and I live in Los Alamitos Creek.

Please fund more affordable housing projects this year.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Support funding for housing

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

I've been a homeowner near Evans Ln and Canoas Garden Ave for 20 years. The new proposal would add a large tax on property owners, and I think the cost should be spread differently. My neighbors and I are retired and we already stretch to pay for our homes each year. Some of us are considering selling because the bills keep going up.

Please reconsider the funding plan and use general revenue instead of a new property tax.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Bond measure is too expensive

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Torrance Avenue y Diamond Avenue desde hace 27 años. Yo soy dueño de mi casa y apoyo que se use dinero público para vivienda económica para nuestros vecinos.

Les pido que aprueben el financiamiento y que informen cada año sobre los resultados.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Apoyo al fondo de vivienda

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
To the City Council,

New housing is fine with me, but the sewer line on our street was not built for many more homes. When it rains hard the manhole covers bubble up, and I am worried about what happens with more connections.

Please require sewer and water capacity checks before the council approves major new housing projects.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Growth needs better sewers

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
I live by S Kiely Blvd and Albany Dr with my family. The elementary school my son attends is already over capacity, and more housing will push it further.

Please coordinate school capacity planning with any new housing approvals.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Schools are full

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Our block has too few spots already, and the new apartments going up are not providing enough parking. Delivery trucks block the lane almost every morning, and I have had to park three streets away.

Please require developers to pay for added parking or transit before new projects are approved.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Parking can't keep up

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hola,

Hay muchas construcciones nuevas y la tubería del agua en mi calle ya tiene fugas frecuentes.

Les pido que revisen la capacidad de agua y drenaje antes de aprobar más proyectos.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Agua y drenaje para las casas nuevas

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Xin chào,

Nhà mới được xây nhiều nhưng trường học và hệ thống nước vẫn chưa được nâng cấp kịp. Con tôi học lớp đông hơn hai mươi học sinh và nước đôi khi bị yếu vào buổi tối.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố kiểm tra sức chứa trường học và nước trước khi cấp phép thêm.

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Trường học và nước sạch

item_title: Citywide fourplex zoning reform
text:
Hi,

Our business depends on workers who need places to live, so I support new housing if it comes with real infrastructure planning. We have lost employees because they could not find anywhere to live nearby. Better roads, sewers, and parking would make these projects work for everyone in the area.

Please tie each major housing approval to a written plan for roads, water, and schools.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Support new homes with an infrastructure plan

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

We live near the corner of Lahaina Way and Ilikai Ave. I am not against growth but I think the city should slow down a little and see what breaks first.

I hope the council keeps a steady pace on new approvals.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Just a thought on growth

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
To the City Council,

Since the new buildings went up, the corner by my kids' bus stop has gotten much busier at rush hour. My family and I live in Los Arboles. Cars back up past the crosswalk and I have seen a few close calls with kids walking in the morning.

Please add a traffic study and a safer crossing before more buildings are approved nearby.

[name removed]
subject: Traffic from new buildings

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I have been reading the staff reports and I do not see a clear plan for water and sewer service in our part of the city. Our water pressure drops during summer evenings, and I wonder how that will work with several new buildings on the same line. I would like to know whether the utility has counted the new connections.

Please publish the water and sewer capacity numbers that were used to approve each new project.

[name removed]
subject: Water and sewer capacity for new units

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
新建住房可以，但是我们这边的排水和供水设施跟不上了。

希望市政府在批准新项目前，先检查供水和排水能力。

[name removed]
subject: 关于新住房与基础设施

[name removed]

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Dear Mayor and Council,

Our corner has been dark since the lights went out last month, and I feel unsafe walking my dog after eight. I already reported it through the 311 app twice and I got an automated response both times.

Please send a crew to restore the light and confirm when it is fixed.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Dark corner after dark

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Estimados concejales,

La luz de la calle cerca de mi casa lleva más de un mes apagada y se oscurece todo el tramo. Vivo cerca de Clovercrest Drive y Glen Brae Lane. Ya la reporté en la aplicación 311 y nadie ha venido a repararla.

Les pido que manden a alguien a repararla y revisen si se robaron los cables.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Luz de la calle apagada

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
To the City Council,

The lights on our side of the street keep going out because someone keeps stealing the copper wire from the poles. This is the third time since spring that we have been left in the dark for a week or more. My wife and I are retired and we do not feel safe walking to the bus at night.

Please replace the stolen wire with a theft-resistant design and check the poles on our side.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Copper wire theft again

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hola,

Ya no puedo caminar a casa de noche porque la calle está completamente a oscuras desde hace semanas.

Les pido que reparen la luz de inmediato porque hay niños que caminan por aquí.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Calle oscura en la noche

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Đèn đường trước nhà tôi đã tắt hơn hai tuần nên đêm rất tối và đi lại không an toàn. Tôi đã báo qua ứng dụng 311 nhưng chưa thấy ai đến sửa.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố cử người đến sửa đèn và kiểm tra dây điện có bị lấy trộm không.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Đèn đường bị hỏng

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hello,

I run a shop near the corner of Ciro Ave and Bailey Ave. Our loading area behind the shop has been dark for a month, and our delivery drivers are complaining.

Please restore the streetlight near our loading area as soon as possible.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Lights out at our loading area

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Hi,

The light pole at the end of our street has been out since the last big storm and no one has come to fix it. I have seen city trucks parked nearby on other days, so this should not be hard to schedule.

Please add this pole to the next repair list and tell us the date.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Streetlight out since the storm

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

Two of the four lights on our block are out and the other two flicker when it rains. We live near the corner of Basking Ridge Ave and Silicon Valley Blvd.

Please check all four poles and replace the parts that are failing.

[name removed]
subject: Two lights down on my block

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

Otra vez robaron los cables de la luz de la esquina y ahora la calle quedó sin alumbrado por varios días. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Aborn Road y Towers Lane desde hace 9 años. Ya hemos reportado esto varias veces y nadie da una fecha de reparación.

Les pido que reparen el alumbrado y pongan un diseño de cables que no se pueda robar fácilmente.

Saludos,
[name removed]
subject: Cables robados de la luz

The light at the bus stop near my house has been dim for a week and sometimes goes completely dark. I live at the corner of Union Ave and Heather Dr. Older folks from our building wait there every morning, and they have asked me to write this email for them.

Please replace the bulb or pole and let us know when the work is scheduled.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Light pole outage question

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

The sidewalk under the streetlight is pitch black after dinner and I cannot see the curb.

Please fix the light so the sidewalk is safe for walkers again.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Dark sidewalk after dinner

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

I live by Lean Ave and Colville Dr with my family. I work nights as a nurse and I walk home past a stretch of dark street most nights. The light on that block has been out for almost a month, and I have started taking a longer route just to stay on lit streets. Last week a stranger was following a coworker and it scared us both.

Please restore the light and add a second light if the block is still too dark.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: My walk home is unsafe

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

[name removed]
subject: Ilaw sa kalsada

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

Please fix it permanently instead of patching the same wires each time.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Light out again

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

Please send a repair crew to the light pole behind our business as soon as possible.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Dark parking lot behind our shop

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

Best,

[name removed]
subject: Poste sin luz

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Chynoweth Ave y Colony Crest Dr desde hace 5 años. Se apagó el alumbrado de nuestra cuadra y la noche se siente peligrosa para los niños.

Les pido que manden una cuadrilla a revisar el cableado y reparar el alumbrado.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Alumbrado apagado en mi cuadra

item_title: Streetlight reliability program and maintenance contract (Story/King corridor)

Please prioritize outages on our street that leave whole blocks dark for more than a week.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Teens walking to practice

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Please fill that pothole and check the pavement along the rest of the block.

[name removed]

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Please reinspect the patch and do a proper repair that lasts more than a few weeks.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Patch job already cracking

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Road crumbling at the edges

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Trân trọng,
[name removed]

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Bache en la calle

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Please prioritize pothole repair on the main delivery routes that serve local businesses.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Delivery trucks and potholes

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
We live near the corner of Chynoweth Ave and Pearl Ave. There is a deep hole at the edge of the lane near the bus stop that my son stepped into last week.

Please fill the hole and mark it until the repair crew can come out.

[name removed]
subject: Hole by the bus stop

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Please move this pothole up the repair list and confirm when it will be filled.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Potholes and tire damage

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Please re-pave the worst section of our street this year instead of patching it again.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Road dips getting worse

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:

Les pido que reparen la calle completa y no solo parchen los huecos más grandes.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Calle destruida por los baches

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

subject: Potholes on my corner

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

Cảm ơn quý vị,
[name removed]
subject: Mặt đường hư hỏng

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Potholes slowing deliveries

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)

[name removed]
subject: Hoyo peligroso

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
To the City Council,

Our street has had the same potholes for two years, and every repair crew only fills them for a few months. I have photos from each season showing the same spot breaking up again, and the repair dates never match the ticket notes. Our car repair bills have added up to more than my monthly grocery budget.

Please assign a permanent repair plan for our street instead of short-term patching.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Pavement falling apart on our street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

The storm drain at the bottom of our street fills with leaves every fall and water backs up over the curb. We live near the corner of Cherry Ave and Avis Dr. Last winter the water got high enough to reach the garage door, and we had to move the car to higher ground.

Please clear the storm drain before the rainy season and add a regular cleaning schedule.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Storm drain clogged again

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Every time it rains hard, the street in front of our building floods and stays wet for hours. I live at the corner of Antonio Ln and Valley Forge Way.

Please clean out the drain grate on our block and check whether it is connected.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Water in the street

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live near Minnesota Ave and W Alma Ave. The water that sits at the low point of our driveway during storms has started seeping into the garage. We have put out sandbags twice this winter, and my husband has had to pump the floor. The neighbors across the street have a similar problem, so it is not just one house.

Please inspect the storm drains at the low point of our block and fix whatever is blocking them.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Flooding at our driveway

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Estimados concejales,

La coladera de la esquina está tapada con hojas y el agua se queda en la calle cada vez que llueve. Nosotros vivimos cerca de Yerba Buena Rd y McLaughlin Ave desde hace 7 años.

Les pido que la limpien antes de la temporada de lluvias y la revisen cada otoño.

Gracias,
[name removed]
subject: Coladera tapada

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Hi,

I run a shop near the corner of Curtner Ave and Heritage Dr. Our loading dock sits lower than the street, and runoff from the storm drain backs up into our building. We had to throw out inventory last January when the water came in, and our insurance claim is still pending.

Please raise the priority of cleaning the storm drain next to our business loading dock.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Flooded loading dock

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Cống thoát nước trước nhà tôi bị tắc nên nước tràn lên vỉa hè mỗi khi trời mưa lớn.

Tôi mong thành phố vét cống này và kiểm tra lại toàn bộ hệ thống thoát nước của khu.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Cống thoát nước bị nghẹt

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

The grate at the corner gets covered by leaves in October and then the water runs straight into my neighbor's yard. Our city crew came once last year, but the next storm filled it right back up.

Please add that grate to the autumn cleaning schedule so it gets cleared before the first big storm.

Best,
[name removed]
subject: Leaves block the grate

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
During the last big storm, water came up over the curb and reached the edge of our garage door. I live by Bay Laurel Ln and Suncrest Ave with my family. We have lived here for twenty years and this is the first time it has come that close. Our neighbor down the block had water inside his shed, and he is still cleaning up the mess.

Please review the drainage capacity on our block and fix any bottleneck the review finds.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Water reaching the garage

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I've been a homeowner near Kingfisher Dr and Skylark Dr for 12 years. The drain by my mailbox overflows every time there is a heavy rain and the sidewalk turns into a pond.

Please clean the drain and check whether the pipe underneath is cracked.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Gutter overflow on our street

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I live at the corner of Santa Teresa Blvd and Indian Ave. After the construction on the next block, sand and gravel washed into the storm drain and it stopped working. The water now sits in the road for hours and cars splash the sidewalk where my kids wait for the bus.

Please inspect the storm drain and ask the contractor to pay for cleanup if needed.

Thanks,
[name removed]
subject: Storm drain clogged by sand

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

I have noticed that the repairs in our part of the city take months longer than the ones on the wealthier side. Our street has been broken for over a year while streets nearby got fixed in a few weeks.

Please publish repair times by area so residents can see whether service is fair.

Respectfully,
[name removed]
subject: Repairs take longer in our part of town

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Buenas tardes,

En mi lado de la ciudad las reparaciones tardan meses, mientras en otras zonas las hacen en pocas semanas. Nosotros también pagamos impuestos y merecemos el mismo servicio que cualquier otra familia.

Les pido que den igual respuesta a todas las zonas, sin importar el ingreso de la gente.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Las reparaciones tardan más en mi zona

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
Estimado Concejo Municipal,

Nosotros vivimos cerca de Nieman Blvd y Cirelli Dr desde hace 16 años. Aquí en nuestra zona los baches tardan meses en arreglarse, mucho más que en otras partes de la ciudad.

Les pido que den prioridad a las reparaciones en las zonas de menos ingresos.

Atentamente,
[name removed]
subject: Desigualdad en las reparaciones

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

The street repair schedule seems to favor the newer subdivisions, and our older blocks keep getting pushed back. We have been waiting almost two years for a simple resurfacing that a neighboring area got in one season.

Please set repair priorities using a clear need-based scoring method that is published online.

[name removed]
subject: Fairness in street repair schedules

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
Hello,

Our shops are on a road that has been on the repair list for three years while corridors in other parts of town get repaved every year. Customers avoid parking near our storefronts because the pavement is so bad, and that hurts sales.

Please schedule our road for repaving on the same cycle as other commercial corridors.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Our commercial strip gets ignored

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
Hello,

I keep comparing the work orders on our block with the ones on the other side of the city, and ours always seem to sit longer. When I called last spring, they told me the crew would come in six weeks, and it took nearly five months. Meanwhile a similar pothole was fixed within days across town.

Please require the city to report how long requests take in each area so gaps can be fixed.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Why does our block always wait?

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
Dear Council Office,

The older blocks in town wait far longer for basic road work than the new developments do.

Please make sure older blocks are included in the next round of repaving.

Thank you,
[name removed]
subject: Older blocks get forgotten

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
to_office: Hội đồng Thành phố / City Council
text:
Kính gửi quý vị,

Khu nhà của chúng tôi chờ sửa đường lâu hơn nhiều so với các khu khá giả hơn trong thành phố. Đường bị hư đã hơn một năm trong khi các con đường gần đó được sửa xong trong vài tuần.

Tôi đề nghị thành phố công bố thời gian sửa chữa theo từng khu vực để mọi người được đối xử công bằng.

Trân trọng,
[name removed]
subject: Sửa đường chậm ở khu chúng tôi

item_title: Pavement maintenance: emergency repair on Alma Avenue and road funding
text:
I've been a homeowner near Whirlaway Dr and Carryback Ave for 27 years. I believe every part of this city should get the same speed on pothole and sidewalk repairs. When we pay the same taxes, the response should not depend on which side of town you live on.

Please audit repair response times across the city and share the results with the public.

Regards,
[name removed]
subject: Equal repairs for everyone

item_title: General correspondence (no agenda item)
text:
We keep calling about the same broken curb and nothing happens, even though the blocks nearby got done last summer.

Please move our street up the list so families here get the same service as everyone else.

Sincerely,
[name removed]
subject: Still waiting on our street
